# Crew NPC bugs: the summary

**Built by `build-index.mjs` from `findings/`; do not edit by hand.** Every open bug, most severe first, and within each severity the easiest fix first. Duplicates, refuted findings and fixed ones are left out. Each bug links to its finding, which has the code, a concrete case, the steps to fix it and how to test it.

Beside each: **confirmed** means a second reviewer tried to prove it wrong and could not. **not checked** means only its finder has looked at it; "finder sure" or "likely" is how sure that finder was. **unsure** means the second reviewer could not settle it.

357 open bugs (253 confirmed), then 93 gaps. 73 findings are closed (duplicates, refuted or fixed) and not listed.

| Severity | Small fix | Medium fix | Large fix | All | Confirmed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| critical | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| high | 1 | 1 | 7 | 9 | 9 |
| medium | 131 | 94 | 14 | 239 | 237 |
| low | 103 | 6 | 0 | 109 | 7 |

Severity: **critical** stops a body, the whole crew or the window for the rest of the round; **high** makes a job fail or loop in a case most rounds will meet, breaks the no-cheats rule, or acts on the wrong person; **medium** is wrong in rarer cases, or noticeable while the work still gets done; **low** is wording, log noise, dead code or a misleading test.

## Bugs: high (9)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 1

1. **[SEC-15](findings/SEC-15-attacker-looked-for-by-name-so-the-baton-can-go-to-someone-else.md)** (confirmed, security): Whoever attacked the officer is looked for by name and not by the handle the server gave, so with two masked Unknowns, or two of one name, the baton goes to whichever is first in view
   - Fix: Find the attacker in peopleInView by beat.attacker.handle first and by name only when no handle came, and send the stop to that handle

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 1

2. **[CARGO-02](findings/CARGO-02-arrival-sent-by-pda-never-reaches-the-quartermaster.md)** (confirmed, cargo): When a technician cannot find the Quartermaster, word that an order came in goes to the head only, and the Quartermaster never gives that technician another order
   - Fix: In the PDA fall-back for an order given by the Quartermaster, also send the Quartermaster the has-come-in line by PDA, which its readsMessage already reads - the owner must first allow a PDA between technician and Quartermaster, which the plan rules out

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 7

3. **[CARGO-01](findings/CARGO-01-order-that-fails-after-placing-is-told-to-nobody.md)** (confirmed, cargo): An order that fails after it was placed is told to nobody, and the Quartermaster's book keeps it as given for good
   - Fix: Have the server owe a notice of kind failed when a placed order is given up, and have the technician pass it on like any other word (to the Quartermaster face to face, or to whoever ordered by PDA)
4. **[HOLE-01](findings/HOLE-01-any-card-that-says-captain-is-the-captain.md)** (confirmed, design): Anyone holding or wearing a card whose job text has "captain" in it is obeyed as the Captain
   - Fix: Have the server work out each person's rank from the card they wear and whether its name matches their face, send that as a field, and have the window go by that field and never by words in the job text
5. **[KNA-04](findings/KNA-04-helper-list-of-cheats-confirmed-in-hands-doors-alarm.md)** (confirmed, hands): The list of cheats a helper reported in older code was never checked - all of it is true and still in the code
   - Fix: Replace each direct call with the click a player makes, starting with hand_over, which puts things into a player's hand
6. **[LOGA-03](findings/LOGA-03-a-mop-clicked-on-a-cobweb-or-rubble-removes-it-but-janitors-are-told-it-needs-soap.md)** (confirmed, logs): A mop clicked on a cobweb or rubble takes it up, but the body only ever mops the floor under it, so every cobweb and pile of rubble is called beyond the mop and starts a round-long soap-or-rag loop
   - Fix: For a mop, click the mess itself when it is not is_mopped, judge a mop by its cleaner strength in can_clean_mess, and count a held mop as able to scrub in janitor.ts
7. **[LOGB-01](findings/LOGB-01-janitor-shut-in-the-hops-office-for-the-rest-of-the-round.md)** (confirmed, doors): A janitor shut in the Head of Personnel's Office stays there for the rest of the round, with the head in the room and asked twice
   - Fix: Let anyone whose own ID opens the room open its door to let out someone inside who asks, not only cargo, and send a head the head form of the shut-in line even when its ID opens the door
8. **[TRUST-02](findings/TRUST-02-forged-pda-sender-taken-for-the-captain.md)** (confirmed, senses): A PDA message with a made-up sender, from the message monitor or a virus disk, is taken as from the Captain or any head it names
   - Fix: Have on_pda_message say whether the message can be replied to, as the PDA itself shows, and have the window pass one that cannot to none of its readers
9. **[TRUST-05](findings/TRUST-05-any-security-pda-gets-any-door-forced-open.md)** (confirmed, engineering): Any PDA that shows a security job can have an engineer pry open any unplated door aboard, the Captain's Quarters and the Armory among them, and leave it standing open
   - Fix: Take a forcing request only from whoever keeps security's list, only for a warrant engineering can check and a room that is not a secure store, and have the Captain say yes to anything in command or security

## Bugs: medium (239)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 131

10. **[ARR-03](findings/ARR-03-baton-used-on-a-head-of-staff-with-no-warrant.md)** (confirmed, security): An officer stops a head of staff with the baton when there is no warrant, which is laying a hand on a head
   - Fix: Refuse the baton with no warrant on anyone who is command, in the stop_attacker task and in tool_arrest, and report it instead
11. **[ARR-07](findings/ARR-07-someone-in-sight-in-its-own-room-it-cannot-walk-to-is-tried-for-ever.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone in sight in the officer's own room whom it cannot walk to is told and tried for ever, and nobody hears why
   - Fix: Count a no_way with nowhere to ask as a failed try, so that it rests after three and reports that it cannot get to them
12. **[ARR-09](findings/ARR-09-told-to-try-again-a-hurt-officer-breaks-off-again-at-once.md)** (confirmed, security): Told to try again, security that is still under half its health breaks off again the same second, and says so again
   - Fix: Remember the health it was told to try again at, and break off again only when it has lost a good deal more since
13. **[ARR-10](findings/ARR-10-short-of-cuffs-with-them-in-sight-it-neither-fetches-nor-tells.md)** (confirmed, security): Short of cuffs, or of a working baton once force is called for, with the person in sight it neither goes for its kit nor tells anyone
   - Fix: Let wantsKit send it for its kit while on lead when the kit is what stops the arrest, and tell whoever keeps the list at once that it is short
14. **[ARR-11](findings/ARR-11-one-hallway-it-cannot-walk-to-stops-the-whole-search.md)** (confirmed, security): One main hallway it cannot walk to stops the whole search, and it stands still between ever longer tries at that one hallway
   - Fix: Skip a hallway in blockedPlaces, and count a walk to a hallway that came to nothing as that hallway looked at, so the round goes on to the next
15. **[ARR-12](findings/ARR-12-server-refusing-to-arrest-a-captain-card-is-read-as-will-not-stand-still.md)** (confirmed, security): The server refusing an arrest because the person carries a Captain's ID is read as them not standing still, and the arrest line is said to them for ever
   - Fix: Read the reason captain in beatAfterActing as final for that person for a while, pass over them in target, and tell whoever keeps the list the true reason once
16. **[ARR-14](findings/ARR-14-waiting-at-a-door-it-asked-to-be-let-through-it-walks-off-on-other-work.md)** (confirmed, security): Having asked to be let in at a door, security walks off on its other warrant or for its kit, and is not there when the door is opened
   - Fix: Set asked true on the wait in letInStep once it is at the door, as the janitor's wait at a door does, so the wait outranks its other asked work
17. **[ARR-17](findings/ARR-17-let-go-of-dan-frees-jordan-whom-it-has-by-the-arm.md)** (confirmed, security): Told to let go of someone by a short name, security frees whoever it has by the arm if that name is anywhere inside theirs
   - Fix: Match names in tool_free and set_free word by word, as sameName does in the window, not with findtext
18. **[ARR-19](findings/ARR-19-someone-who-fought-back-and-is-behind-a-locked-counter-is-never-asked-about.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone in sight across a locked counter who has fought back, or who stands within two tiles, is never asked to be let in to, and security walks, shouts and fails at them for ever
   - Fix: Gate the let-in branch on shutOut alone, for the room they are in, dropping both the not-resisted and the more-than-two-tiles conditions
19. **[ASYNC-07](findings/ASYNC-07-optional-remark-stops-the-body-mid-walk-while-the-model-is-asked.md)** (confirmed, brain): A remark the NPC may or may not make stops its body mid-walk, and holds back its next walk, for as long as the model takes to be asked
   - Fix: Do not send hold, and do not count the NPC as talking in drive, when all it is queued for is a remark of its own, and only stand still once the model has given a line to say
20. **[BRAIN-01](findings/BRAIN-01-deaf-to-a-player-after-six-replies.md)** (confirmed, brain): After six replies to a player an NPC stops hearing them until they keep quiet for 30 seconds
   - Fix: Count replies to a player over a rolling minute, set lastHeardAt only for a line that is let through, and make out an order by code from a capped line said by someone the NPC answers to
21. **[BRAIN-03](findings/BRAIN-03-dropped-line-asked-again-at-once-in-a-tight-loop.md)** (confirmed, brain): A line dropped before the model is asked is asked for again at once, in a loop that uses up the body's tool calls
   - Fix: Make letInStep's sayIf test only the door it waits at, and when think drops a line for its sayIf hold the driver off a few seconds and clear the mustSay fields
22. **[BRAIN-05](findings/BRAIN-05-lead-offer-made-on-ordinary-words.md)** (confirmed, brain): A janitor is offered "lead them somewhere" on words like take, way and get to, and walks off to a room nobody asked for
   - Fix: Offer the walk only when a line said to this NPC both asks the way and names a room, and have code check a go_to against what was said as it does an order
23. **[BRAIN-06](findings/BRAIN-06-anyone-named-in-its-own-line-becomes-who-it-is-talking-with.md)** (confirmed, brain): Anyone the NPC names in its own line, even in passing or by a word like hope or may, becomes who it is talking with, and the one it was answering is dropped
   - Fix: After saying a line, set inTalkWith only to someone the line calls on (callsOn from addressing.ts) or else leave it on the speaker it was answering
24. **[BRAIN-07](findings/BRAIN-07-line-no-longer-needed-is-said-when-the-model-fails-or-someone-spoke.md)** (confirmed, brain): A line that has stopped needing saying while the model thought is said all the same when the call fails, and is kept inside the answer when someone had also spoken
   - Fix: Test mustSayIf again in the catch of think before the plain line is said, and when it is false with speakers present ask that the line be left out or say the plain answer only
25. **[BRAIN-09](findings/BRAIN-09-question-put-as-a-word-for-word-line-is-due-is-never-answered.md)** (confirmed, brain): Someone who speaks to an NPC just as a word-for-word line is due gets that line and a remark, never an answer, and is not heard again
   - Fix: When a word-for-word line goes out in a call that also had speakers, put the speakers and their lines back and wake the NPC again so the next call answers them, unless the line was said to one of them
26. **[BRAIN-12](findings/BRAIN-12-any-line-said-counts-as-telling-everyone-in-view-their-work-is-done.md)** (confirmed, brain): Any line the NPC says marks every finished task whose asker is in view as reported, so a greeting or one done to Ann leaves the Captain never told
   - Fix: Mark a finished task reported only when the line said names its asker and was the done line or holds the done words, and say one done line per asker
27. **[CARGO-07](findings/CARGO-07-dead-model-fallback-orders-on-any-mention-of-order-or-crate.md)** (confirmed, cargo): With the model down, a head who says the word order or crate for any reason has a Janitorial Supplies Crate ordered for them
   - Fix: In hears, place an order only when the words name a kind of crate that can be ordered and are put as an ask, and never fall back to the first crate on the list
28. **[CARGO-08](findings/CARGO-08-come-for-my-crate-with-no-number-is-told-no-such-crate.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Someone who comes for their own crate and does not give the number in a set form is told no crate is held by that number
   - Fix: In crateMeant fall back to the crates held for the speaker, read more ways of giving a number, and say there is no crate for you instead of by that number when none was given
29. **[CARGO-11](findings/CARGO-11-no-janitor-called-while-the-rooms-keeper-is-gone.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Once the rooms are given to one technician, the other never sends for a janitor, even when that technician is dead, in the brig or gone
   - Fix: In tidyStep leave the call to the keeper only while leftTo says they are about, as every other piece of the standing work does
30. **[CARGO-12](findings/CARGO-12-workmate-down-or-in-cuffs-still-counts-as-about.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A workmate lying knocked out, dead or in cuffs in plain sight still counts as about, so their share of the work is left to them for good
   - Fix: Write one helper, ableWorkmate, that needs the person in view to be neither down nor cuffed, and use it in leftTo, doorIsMine, the knock rule and visitorToMind
31. **[CARGO-13](findings/CARGO-13-collector-asks-the-same-technician-every-minute-with-no-end.md)** (confirmed, supply): Someone sent for a crate asks the first technician in sight every minute for up to half an hour, even one who is down, and then drops the errand without telling anyone
   - Fix: Ask a technician who is on their feet, turn to another after an ask that brought nothing, and after three asks tell the head who sent it and put the errand off
32. **[CARGO-14](findings/CARGO-14-lights-for-the-janitor-orders-a-janitorial-crate.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Light bulbs for the janitor is ordered as a Janitorial Supplies Crate, because each clause gives one kind only, the first on the list, and janitor names the janitorial crate
   - Fix: In itemsAskedFor strip who the order is for before matching, split on question and exclamation marks too, and take every kind a clause names by its own words rather than the first kind on the list
33. **[CARGO-15](findings/CARGO-15-order-that-says-someone-will-collect-it-is-taken-for-a-pickup.md)** (confirmed, cargo): An order that says who will come for the crate, I'll send someone to pick it up, is taken for someone come to collect, told no crate is held, and not placed
   - Fix: Take a line as someone come for a crate only when it does not also ask for one to be ordered, and read the collect words only when they are about a crate that is already here
34. **[CHEAT-10](findings/CHEAT-10-who-belongs-and-who-outranks-read-off-card-access.md)** (confirmed, senses): Whether someone in view belongs in a post, or outranks the body, is read off the hidden access list and trim of their card, not the job the card shows
   - Fix: Judge belongs and command from the job title the card shows and the access that job is given, the way a player reading the card would
35. **[CHK-07](findings/CHK-07-walked-out-on-purpose-still-counts-as-in-the-room-for-ten-seconds.md)** (confirmed, brain): A body that walks out of a room on purpose still counts as in it for ten seconds, so a Quartermaster in its office calls its meeting by PDA as if it stood in the bay
   - Fix: Record leftPlace in ingest only when the body was not walking and brain.lastAct holds no walk the driver sent (any tool outside STAYS but step_aside), so stillIn means pushed out and not walked out
36. **[CORE-06](findings/CORE-06-careful-step-blocks-moves-the-body-did-not-make.md)** (confirmed, core): The careful step near slippery things blocks every move of the body, including being pulled, so a crew member dragged across a peel or soap slips out of the grip
   - Fix: In mind_its_step, only slow down for a step the body takes itself, and return at once when the move comes from a pull, a throw or being carried
37. **[CORE-09](findings/CORE-09-body-holding-another-id-takes-its-job-for-its-own.md)** (confirmed, core): A crew member holding someone else's ID card, or a PDA with one in it, takes that card's job for its own, on the server and in the window, for as long as it holds it
   - Fix: Read the body's own job from crew_npc_own_card (worn card first, hand only if none worn), and send that same job_title() to the window instead of get_assignment
38. **[CORE-10](findings/CORE-10-window-opened-on-the-lobby-closes-when-the-owner-joins.md)** (confirmed, core): When the owner is still in the lobby ten seconds into the round, the brain window is opened on the lobby mob and is shut the moment they join or observe, so no crew member is driven until they reopen it by hand
   - Fix: Open the brain window through one helper that, when the owner's mob is a lobby mob, waits for COMSIG_CLIENT_MOB_LOGIN on their client and opens it on the new mob
39. **[CORE-11](findings/CORE-11-walk-held-back-by-a-grab-or-chair-is-told-no-way-through.md)** (confirmed, core): A walk the body cannot take because someone has hold of it, it is cuffed and pulled, or it is buckled to a chair, is told there is no way through, with all that follows
   - Fix: In the walk leaf, when the move loop gave up because the body was not allowed to move, say why from what the body can feel (held, cuffed and held, buckled, off its feet) instead of CREW_NPC_NO_WAY, and do not count it as a way out that failed
40. **[DESK-01](findings/DESK-01-any-pda-message-a-janitor-cannot-read-is-taken-for-supplies-come.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Any PDA message a janitor cannot read is taken to mean its supplies have come, and sends it to the Cargo Lobby
   - Fix: Set suppliesSentAt in the janitor's readsMessage only when the message has the head's fixed words what you asked for has come, and ignore every other message
41. **[DESK-03](findings/DESK-03-dry-mop-and-a-rag-with-no-sink-in-sight-never-goes-to-a-sink.md)** (confirmed, janitor): A janitor with a dry mop and a rag and no sink in sight never goes to a sink, and every mess task is stuck on wetting it here
   - Fix: In plan, take the mopNeedsWater step only when brain.sinkInView, and when brain.dryMop is set and the mess is elsewhere return supplyStep's sink walk, moved into a shared helper
42. **[DESK-05](findings/DESK-05-with-no-head-of-security-and-two-officers-no-warrant-is-served.md)** (confirmed, security): With no Head of Security and two officers, the officer who keeps the list hands every warrant to the other, who does not read it, so nobody serves any
   - Fix: With no Head of Security, have each officer keep and serve its own list (serving returns null for an officer keeping the desk, and strike and try-again use serving too), or have officers read a fellow officer's give, seen and let-go lines with takeWord
43. **[DOOR-01](findings/DOOR-01-held-door-shuts-on-those-not-yet-through.md)** (confirmed, doors): A door held for several people shuts on the rest when the one watched longest goes through first
   - Fix: Count who is still to come through each held door and shut it only when the last of them is through or every hold has run out
44. **[DOOR-03](findings/DOOR-03-shut-in-test-counts-locked-rooms-and-no-rooms.md)** (confirmed, doors): The test for being shut in can say yes in a hallway, and says yes when it has tested nothing
   - Fix: In check_shut_in test routes first to the far side of each door of the room it stands in, leave out rooms locked to the body, and never conclude shut in from zero routes tested
45. **[DOOR-04](findings/DOOR-04-dead-door-refused-for-tools-it-does-not-need.md)** (confirmed, doors): A door with no power is refused for want of a screwdriver, a multitool and wire skill, when a crowbar alone opens it
   - Fix: In tool_force_door ask for the screwdriver, the multitool and the wire skill only when the door to be forced has power, and for the crowbar always
46. **[DOOR-09](findings/DOOR-09-room-with-a-door-open-at-that-instant-counts-as-open.md)** (confirmed, doors): A locked room counts as open to all for the whole round if one of its doors stood open at the instant it was looked at
   - Fix: In the open-way test of crew_npc_room_is_closed pass over any tile that holds an airlock, a windoor or plastic flaps, so only a way with no door on it counts
47. **[DOOR-11](findings/DOOR-11-fire-alarm-reset-reported-when-nothing-was-reset.md)** (confirmed, doors): Resetting a fire alarm is reported as done when the alarm has no power or cannot be reset
   - Fix: Reset the alarm by the right click a player uses, then look at the room and answer by whether its alarm is in fact off
48. **[DRV-01](findings/DRV-01-step-clear-tries-used-up-before-any-step.md)** (confirmed, driver): The two tries at stepping clear of a doorway are used up while the driver is waiting, so a body that arrives in a doorway mostly stays in it
   - Fix: Count a step clear when the step is issued (in drive, beside noteDone), not when nextStep asks whether one is allowed
49. **[DRV-11](findings/DRV-11-shut-in-and-unable-to-reach-the-door-it-never-sends-word.md)** (confirmed, driver): Shut in and unable to get to the door, a body never knocks and never sends PDA word, because both wait on it standing at the door
   - Fix: Send the PDA word, worded for where it is, when go_to_door has failed and is held back, instead of only from the door
50. **[ENG-04](findings/ENG-04-door-job-handed-to-an-engineer-is-waited-on-for-ever.md)** (confirmed, engineering): A door the Chief Engineer has handed to an engineer is waited on for ever, and security, told "I am sending X", hears nothing more if X never reports
   - Fix: Give each entry of forcing.sent a time limit, and when it passes with no word back tell whoever asked that engineering has not opened the room, keeping the entry marked so a late word from the engineer is still passed on
51. **[ENG-05](findings/ENG-05-light-the-engine-words-take-do-not-light-and-miss-relight.md)** (confirmed, engineering): The Captain's "light the engine" is read from any line holding those three words, so "do not light the engine" relights it, while "relight the engine" is not read at all
   - Fix: Read the order to light the engine again with a pattern that takes relight, restart and start up as well, after stripping a leading name, and refuses a line with a negation just before the verb or ending in a question mark
52. **[ENG-08](findings/ENG-08-after-one-shut-off-the-chief-engineer-never-watches-the-crystal-again.md)** (confirmed, engineering): After one shut-off the Chief Engineer stops watching the crystal, so an engine lit again by anyone but its own order loses integrity unwatched
   - Fix: Clear chief.shut when the engine is heard to be lit or on again, or when the crystal's energy is seen rising after the emitters were reported off, so that the usual integrity watch runs again
53. **[ENG-09](findings/ENG-09-chief-engineer-waits-in-engineering-for-its-engineer-with-no-time-limit.md)** (confirmed, engineering): When an order will not go by PDA the Chief Engineer goes to Engineering and waits there for its engineer with no time limit, doing nothing else
   - Fix: Give the look-for-the-engineer wait a time limit, after which the order is sent by PDA again and, for the shut order, the Captain is told the engineer cannot be reached
54. **[ENG-11](findings/ENG-11-with-no-engineer-the-shut-order-is-dropped-and-the-captain-told-it-is-done.md)** (confirmed, engineering): With no engineer to give it to, the emitters-off order is dropped without a word, while the Captain is told the emitters are being switched off and every report after says the engine was shut off
   - Fix: When the shut order has nobody to go to, tell the Captain nobody is aboard to switch the emitters off, raise the order again when an engineer turns up, and stop saying the engine has been shut off before it is heard to be
55. **[GAP-23](findings/GAP-23-model-lines-over-200-characters-are-cut-mid-word-by-the-server.md)** (confirmed, brain): A line the model words that runs past 200 characters is cut mid-word by the server, after the window has checked it holds the words a hearer needs
   - Fix: Trim every say to the last whole sentence that fits in 200 characters in the window, before the needs test, and fall back to the plain line if the trimmed one no longer holds the needed words
56. **[HAND-03](findings/HAND-03-asterisk-in-a-line-turns-speech-into-an-emote.md)** (confirmed, tools): An asterisk anywhere in a line turns the words before it into an emote, and the crew do not hear them
   - Fix: Take every asterisk out of the text in tool_say before it is said, not only the ones at the start
57. **[HAND-07](findings/HAND-07-person-inside-a-searched-locker-is-shut-back-in-and-not-reported.md)** (confirmed, hands): A person found inside a locker it searches tumbles out, is shut back in 0.8 seconds later, and the brain is told only what items were inside
   - Fix: In look_inside and take_from_container note any living mob that came out on opening, leave the container open if one is on its tile, and tell the brain who was inside
58. **[JAN-01](findings/JAN-01-scrub-cut-short-is-taken-as-mess-that-will-not-come-off.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A scrub cut short, by the body being sent elsewhere, moved or knocked down, is taken as a mess that will not come off
   - Fix: In clean_mess, mark a mess stubborn only if the body stayed on its errand, in reach and fit, and the scrub ran its course, else return a plain could not finish
59. **[JAN-02](findings/JAN-02-mop-taken-as-unable-to-shift-garbage-and-molten-mess.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A wet mop is taken as unable to shift decomposing garbage and a gooey grey mass, which it does shift, so a janitor leaves them or swaps its mop for a rag
   - Fix: In can_clean_mess judge a mop by its cleaner component strength (CLEAN_SCRUB) and is_mopped, not by CLEAN_WASH, and take garbage and gooey grey mass out of SCRUB_KINDS for a body with a mop
60. **[JAN-05](findings/JAN-05-table-it-could-not-reach-is-chosen-again-for-every-thing-tidied.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A table or bin the body could not walk to is marked skipped but never looked at again, so every thing tidied is picked up, carried at it and dropped
   - Fix: Make nearest_surface and nearest_bin skip a place with a fresh tidy_skipped entry, as wants_tidying already does for things
61. **[JAN-09](findings/JAN-09-machine-state-checked-a-second-before-a-toggling-click.md)** (confirmed, engineering): A pump, filter or emitter is looked at a second before the click that toggles it, so if anyone sets it in that second the body sets it back, an emitter switched off is switched on again
   - Fix: Do the click gap first and look at the machine after it, just before the click, in turn_machine and switch_emitter, and never click a toggle on a machine already as wanted
62. **[JOBS-02](findings/JOBS-02-crate-errand-dropped-at-half-an-hour-while-hauling-or-after-unpacking.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A crate errand still on the go half an hour after the head sent for it is thrown away mid-haul or after unpacking, so the head is never told and the empty crate is never taken back
   - Fix: Give a Task a keepUntil that the give-up rule in syncTasks honours, and have pickups push it on when the crate is put out, when collect_crate succeeds and when the empty is being taken back
63. **[JOBS-06](findings/JOBS-06-one-failed-step-aside-shuts-out-every-later-ask-for-up-to-two-minutes.md)** (confirmed, driver): One step aside that finds nowhere to go puts every later ask to step aside off for 20 seconds to 2 minutes, and a busy body asked meanwhile has its own work sent again
   - Fix: Key the aside step by the asking (ASIDE_STEP_KEY plus asked.at) so each new ask gets a try, and only let dropToMove break into busy work when that aside step is not in back-off
64. **[KNA-05](findings/KNA-05-thing-handed-over-during-an-errand-is-kept-for-good.md)** (confirmed, hands): A thing pushed into a hand while the body is on any errand is taken for its own and carried for the rest of the shift
   - Fix: During an errand, count a thing as its own only if the errand is one that picks things up and the thing is what it went for, and queue the rest to be put down
65. **[KNA-06](findings/KNA-06-officer-stops-mid-arrest-to-greet-strangers.md)** (confirmed, brain): An officer in the middle of an arrest stops to greet people it has not met
   - Fix: In shouldWake, do not wake the voice for a first meeting while the body is on a warrant's lead (onLead, which covers the Head of Security too) or its job's keptFromMeeting hook says it cannot break off
66. **[KNA-30](findings/KNA-30-kit-drawn-by-clicking-it-inside-a-shut-belt-or-bag.md)** (confirmed, hands): Baton, cuffs and an engineer's tools are drawn by clicking them where they lie inside a belt or bag that was never opened, which a player cannot click
   - Fix: In draw_item, when the thing is inside a storage other than the body, right-click each storage it is in first (outermost first), the open click a player makes, then click the thing
67. **[KNA-31](findings/KNA-31-open-door-rule-misses-locked-hallways-the-case-it-was-built-for.md)** (confirmed, doors): The rule against a way in through a locked door that stands open this minute is skipped for hallways, so the officer can still walk into the Service Hallway behind a janitor, the case it was written for
   - Fix: In tool_go_to_door test every route with route_by_open_door, whatever room the door opens from, and in particular treat a hallway with doors of its own as locked by hallway_locked_to
68. **[KNB-10](findings/KNB-10-technician-answers-orders-spoken-to-nobody-across-the-bay.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A technician answers an order the Captain spoke to the Quartermaster from seven tiles off, because a line said to nobody passes the not-said-to-someone-else test
   - Fix: Take a spoken order or a come-for-my-crate line only when it was said to this technician, or was said to nobody by someone standing at its counter
69. **[LIFE-01](findings/LIFE-01-walk-cut-short-by-a-stun-marks-the-room-as-no-way-in.md)** (confirmed, core): A walk cut short because the body was knocked down marks the room it was going to as one with no way in, for five minutes
   - Fix: Give a walk that ends because the controller stopped running its own reason, and only mark blocked_places for a walk that found no way or ran out of time
70. **[LIFE-03](findings/LIFE-03-route-test-ends-by-overriding-a-newer-order.md)** (confirmed, core): Explore, force door and go to door test routes in a sleep and then start their walk over whatever the body was told to do meanwhile
   - Fix: Note errand_serial before the route tests and drop the result if it has moved on, and report the body as busy while it tests routes
71. **[LIFE-05](findings/LIFE-05-stunned-mid-errand-a-second-copy-of-the-errand-starts.md)** (confirmed, core): A body stunned in the middle of a long errand starts a second copy of the same errand when it gets up, while the first is still running
   - Fix: Keep a per-controller flag that an errand run is in flight, cleared however the run ends, and have crew_npc_do_errand and the errand's crew_npc_reach wait on it instead of starting a second run or walking against the first
72. **[LOGA-02](findings/LOGA-02-meeting-closed-on-a-technician-out-of-view-for-three-seconds-who-then-stands-seven-minutes.md)** (confirmed, logs): The Quartermaster closes its meeting the moment a technician it called is out of its view for three seconds, and that technician then stands seven minutes in the bay waiting for it
   - Fix: Before the closing line, wait a short while for anyone invited who has given no report and was in view or said they were coming, and tell anyone invited and unheard by PDA that the meeting is over
73. **[LOGA-05](findings/LOGA-05-janitor-holding-two-rags-can-never-take-up-the-mop-and-walks-to-and-fro-for-six-minutes.md)** (confirmed, logs): A janitor holding two rags can never take up the mop its head ordered for it, and walks to and fro between the closet and elsewhere for six minutes
   - Fix: In free_a_hand, count a held thing as spare when the other hand holds another of the same type, so one of two rags goes in the bag and the mop can be taken up; the window guards are optional
74. **[LOGB-04](findings/LOGB-04-quartermaster-answers-one-knock-again-and-again-for-a-minute.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): The Quartermaster answers one knock at its office door again and again for a minute, walking out and back each time
   - Fix: Clear brain.knockAt in syncTasks as soon as the Quartermaster is out of its office after a knock, not only in afterActing where the task it looks for has already been thrown away
75. **[MAP-04](findings/MAP-04-prisoners-taken-to-the-cargo-checkpoint-cell-on-delta-and-tram.md)** (confirmed, security): On Tramstation every prisoner taken on the brig's level is walked to the Cargo Cell at the cargo checkpoint, because cells are tried in order of name and not by where they are
   - Fix: In free_cell try the free cells nearest first, brig cells before checkpoint cells, and on a map with no brig cell let the window's brig be the room with the nearest cell
76. **[MAP-05](findings/MAP-05-spawn-looks-only-at-the-lowest-floor-so-icebox-puts-the-whole-crew-at-the-owners-feet.md)** (confirmed, design): The standing crew is placed only on the lowest station floor, so on IceBox all eleven are piled at the owner's feet and on the other multi-floor maps half are, or land in the wrong department
   - Fix: Look for each job's rooms on every station level in crew_npc_spawn_turf, trying the rooms in order across all levels before the broad fallbacks, and never fall back to the owner's turf off the station
77. **[MAP-06](findings/MAP-06-quartermaster-and-technicians-can-be-given-different-cargo-rooms.md)** (confirmed, cargo): The technicians' post and the room the Quartermaster looks for them in are each the supply console nearest that body at spawn, so on a map with consoles in two cargo rooms they can differ
   - Fix: Choose the cargo post once for the station (the cargo-area supply console in the room with the most cargo floor, or the one nearest the counter room), keep it in a global, and give the same room to every technician and to the Quartermaster
78. **[MEM-02](findings/MEM-02-a-note-that-corrects-an-older-one-is-dropped-and-the-old-one-kept.md)** (confirmed, memory): A note that corrects an older one is dropped as a copy of it, and the old one is kept
   - Fix: When a new note is the same as an old one, put the new note in the old one's place instead of dropping the new one
79. **[MEM-06](findings/MEM-06-may-i-come-in-is-taken-as-said-to-anyone-called-may.md)** (confirmed, memory): May I come in is taken as said to anyone aboard called May, even when the speaker is alone with the NPC
   - Fix: In callsOn accept a name at the start with no comma after it only for someone in view, and for anyone not in view require the comma or colon
80. **[MEM-11](findings/MEM-11-work-blocked-over-thirty-minutes-is-dropped-the-moment-it-can-go-on.md)** (confirmed, memory): Work blocked for over thirty minutes never lapses while blocked, and is dropped the instant it can go on again
   - Fix: Count a task's age for giving up from when it last became open, not from when it was made, and give blocked work a limit of its own
81. **[MULTI-03](findings/MULTI-03-workmate-whose-card-is-gone-owns-up-to-trespass-and-is-walked-out-of-its-own-post.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A technician whose ID card has been taken is questioned by its own workmate, answers that nobody sent for it, and is walked out of its own post and locked out for the round
   - Fix: Never open a stranger record on someone in brain.workmates (and drop any open one), and have explainStep answer "I work here" when the room is its own post
82. **[PARSE-03](findings/PARSE-03-short-known-first-name-with-words-after-it-is-not-found.md)** (confirmed, security): A warrant on someone known by a first name of three letters fails if any word follows it, so arrest bob pls is a warrant on bob pls and nobody is arrested
   - Fix: In readWarrant, before closeName, try each leading run of the cut words against known first names and full names exactly, so the first word alone can find its one owner
83. **[PARSE-04](findings/PARSE-04-move-pls-and-excuse-me-do-not-ask-it-to-step-aside.md)** (confirmed, brain): Move pls, excuse me, coming through and let me pass do not ask a body to step aside, while I moved the bucket out of the way and can you move the crate do
   - Fix: Match ASIDE_WORDS against the whole short line for move, excuse me and coming through, accept u and pls, and refuse you move when an object follows and out of the way when a thing is named before it
84. **[PARSE-06](findings/PARSE-06-order-paper-and-lightbulbs-name-no-crate.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Order paper, order lightbulbs and order jani supplies name no crate, and are answered I cannot order that
   - Fix: Give every orderable crate words it goes by in CRATE_ASKED_AS, the Bureaucracy Crate paper, pens and stationery, lights lightbulbs, and match the janitor words as word starts
85. **[PARSE-07](findings/PARSE-07-a-stranger-who-calls-the-guard-by-name-is-put-out.md)** (confirmed, brain): A stranger who answers the guard by its name, Donna the Quartermaster asked me to come in, is taken to have named the guard as who let them in and is put out at once
   - Fix: In the stranger's answer, skip the guard's name where it is used to address the guard (at the start, or set off by a comma), read job titles and their shorthand as the workmate who holds them, and match a workmate by first name only
86. **[PARSE-08](findings/PARSE-08-im-locked-out-is-read-as-wanting-out.md)** (confirmed, cargo): I'm locked out, open the door is read as asking to be let out, and I want to leave, open the door from inside is not read as asking out, so neither door is opened
   - Fix: Decide in or out by where the asker stands when the technician can see them, and otherwise by let me out, leave, get out, done in, never by the bare word out
87. **[QM-04](findings/QM-04-own-crate-lost-is-tried-for-ever-and-blocks-ordering-paper.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): A crate the Quartermaster ordered for itself that is lost before it opens it is tried for the rest of the round, keeps it out of its office, and stops it ever ordering paper again
   - Fix: Mark an own order's crate as done with when it is reported lost or when open_own_crate answers no_such_crate, so the unpack task ends and orderForItself is free again
88. **[QM-05](findings/QM-05-technician-sent-to-a-shut-in-workmate-does-not-go.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): Told that a technician is shut in, the Quartermaster sends another to see to it, and the one sent only takes on the shuttle and the rooms and never goes to the door
   - Fix: Have the technician who hears it is to see to someone shut in note it as a let-out ask for that room, the way a PDA from the shut-in person is noted, so it walks to that door, and let the Quartermaster go itself when no other technician is about
89. **[QM-12](findings/QM-12-lost-crate-reordered-once-per-order-so-a-chain-never-ends.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): A lost crate is meant to be ordered again once, but each reorder is a new order with its own once, so crates that keep being lost are bought again and again
   - Fix: Mark the reorder itself as reordered in crateLost, and in readBook mark order N from a Lost line that says Ordered again as order N, so a lost reorder is told and written but not bought again
90. **[RT-05](findings/RT-05-runtime-inside-an-errand-leaves-the-body-busy-for-good.md)** (confirmed, core): A runtime error anywhere inside an errand or a storage look leaves the body counted as busy for the rest of the round, and the window never sends it anything again
   - Fix: Wrap do_errand and look_inside in try-catch in their perform_async so a thrown error still closes the errand with a failed result, and add a server-side time limit on an errand that clears its key
91. **[SEC-04](findings/SEC-04-cell-it-cannot-walk-to-is-tried-over-and-over.md)** (confirmed, security): A cell the officer cannot walk to, or whose timer will not work, is picked again every time and the other cells are never tried
   - Fix: Call cell_refuses for the cell in jail_cell whenever a jail errand ends in no_way or timer, including the walk that never reached the timer
92. **[SECT-04](findings/SECT-04-taking-back-a-warrant-works-in-one-word-order-only.md)** (confirmed, security): A head can take back its warrant only with the verb before the word warrant, and neither the LLM reader nor the not-followed line knows taking back exists
   - Fix: Also read a warrant said to be withdrawn or cancelled after the word warrant, give the LLM reader a withdraw kind, and put the take-back wording in the not-followed line
93. **[SECT-05](findings/SECT-05-twenty-minutes-or-an-hour-is-read-as-the-reason.md)** (confirmed, security): A time in words past fifteen, or given as half an hour or an hour, is read as the reason and the warrant gets five minutes
   - Fix: Read the tens as words and half an hour or an hour as 30 and 60, then cap at the most a cell allows as digits are capped now
94. **[SECT-08](findings/SECT-08-sent-in-by-the-captain-or-its-own-head-is-no-answer-and-is-put-out.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone in a locked room who answers that the Captain or their own head sent them is taken to have given no answer, and is walked out
   - Fix: Let the answer name anyone the guard knows to be the Captain or a head as well as a workmate, ask them if they are in sight, and take the word otherwise, or ask the owner which
95. **[SECT-09](findings/SECT-09-a-yes-with-no-problem-or-not-in-it-is-read-as-a-no.md)** (confirmed, security): A workmate's yes that has no or not anywhere in it, such as Yes I asked him in, no problem, is read as a no and the visitor is walked out
   - Fix: Take out set phrases such as no problem and not yet, read the answer from how it begins (no first), and only then look through the whole line
96. **[SECT-11](findings/SECT-11-warrant-declared-while-the-officer-is-out-is-lost-on-try-again.md)** (confirmed, security): A warrant declared while the officer is out hurt is marked given, so after try again the Head of Security hands it back and the officer is never told of it
   - Fix: In syncDesk, remember who was serving last time, and when it changes from nobody to an officer set every warrant the Head of Security does not have by the arm back to given no, so the give task hands it over
97. **[SECT-12](findings/SECT-12-any-number-of-minutes-after-a-warrant-changes-its-time.md)** (confirmed, security): Any line from the Captain in the five minutes after a warrant that has it or him and a number of minutes in it changes the warrant's time
   - Fix: Read a time as a term only with a holding verb and him, her or them before it, or as make it N minutes alone, or N minutes for him, and never in a question
98. **[SECT-13](findings/SECT-13-trespass-warrant-on-unknown-names-everyone-with-a-hidden-face.md)** (confirmed, security): A masked trespasser shows as Unknown, its head declares a warrant on Unknown, and the officer then arrests anyone whose face is hidden
   - Fix: Refuse a warrant on the name Unknown, and have whoever could not put an Unknown out tell their head what they saw instead of a name
99. **[SECT-15](findings/SECT-15-sighting-by-first-name-is-told-there-is-no-warrant.md)** (confirmed, security): Word that a wanted person is somewhere, given by first name or run together, is answered there is no warrant on them, though there is
   - Fix: Find the wanted name in a sighting the way a pardon finds it, nameIn then closeIn over the standing names, before saying there is no warrant
100. **[SECT-21](findings/SECT-21-wanted-on-the-bridge-and-wasted-are-read-as-warrants.md)** (confirmed, security): Walker is wanted on the bridge, Dana is wasted and put Dana up for the night shift are each read as a warrant, the spelling mender making wanted out of wasted and waited
   - Fix: Refuse is wanted when a place word follows it, keep the mender off the ordinary words it turns into key words, and allow up in the lock-around pattern only after lock
101. **[SECT-22](findings/SECT-22-drop-or-cancel-anywhere-before-warrant-withdraws-it.md)** (confirmed, security): Drop, call off or cancel anywhere before the word warrant takes a warrant back, even Don't cancel the warrant, and a new warrant in the same line is lost
   - Fix: Take a warrant back only when the cancel verb has the warrant (or "the arrest of" the person) as its object within two words, with no negation in front; otherwise fall through to the pardon and warrant readers as now
102. **[SENSE-01](findings/SENSE-01-throw-out-drags-the-down-and-takes-people-from-others-grip.md)** (confirmed, senses): The keeper of a room drags out a stranger who is out cold, dead or in cuffs, and pulls someone out of another person's grip, the Captain's included
   - Fix: In why_not_put_out refuse when the person is down, cuffed, or already pulled by someone else, and in syncGuarding do not count unanswered asks of a person who is down
103. **[SENSE-05](findings/SENSE-05-walk-out-door-chosen-without-looking-at-its-power.md)** (confirmed, senses): The door to walk a stranger out by is picked without looking at whether it has power, so once the station power fails the walk out makes for a door that will not open
   - Fix: In spot_outside_post skip a shut door that has no power (door.density && !door.hasPower()), so the spot is never put past a door the route planner will not go through
104. **[SENSE-10](findings/SENSE-10-pda-message-lost-while-in-a-locker-or-the-pipes.md)** (confirmed, senses): A PDA message that comes while the body is in a locker, a crate, the disposal pipes or a mech is thrown away, because the test for the PDA being on it stops at the locker
   - Fix: In on_pda_message test that the PDA is somewhere inside the body by walking up its loc to the body, not that the topmost thing on the turf is the body
105. **[SENSE-11](findings/SENSE-11-emergency-access-makes-everyone-belong-in-every-post.md)** (confirmed, senses): Once emergency maintenance access is on, or the AI opens a door's emergency access, everyone belongs in every post that has such a door, and no stranger is ever questioned there
   - Fix: In belongs_in_post test the person's access against the door's own requirements (check_access_list on their access) instead of door.allowed, so an emergency-open door is not taken for a right to be there
106. **[SUP-03](findings/SUP-03-take-in-hand-drops-the-order-book-on-the-floor.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): With both hands full the Quartermaster drops its clipboard, sheet or pen on the floor when it only meant to check for a free hand
   - Fix: Make take_in_hand try only empty hands with can_put_in_hand and put_in_hand, which never drop, and put an old book sheet away before taking a new one
107. **[SUP-13](findings/SUP-13-crate-of-another-order-taken-by-its-name.md)** (confirmed, supply): When one of an order's crates did not come, order_arrived takes another order's crate of the same kind for it by its name, and that order's technician then cannot find its own
   - Fix: In the by-name pass of order_arrived skip any crate that still has a manifest or whose name ends in another order's number, and read the number from the name when the manifest is gone
108. **[TRA-01](findings/TRA-01-one-crate-counted-for-three-janitors-holds-two-tools.md)** (confirmed, supply): The head orders one crate for every three janitors short, but a crate of janitorial supplies holds only two things a janitor counts as proper tools
   - Fix: Count a Janitorial Supplies Crate as good for two janitors (its mop and its spray cleaner), not three, and give the simulator's crate the rag the real one has
109. **[TRA-03](findings/TRA-03-no-such-crate-heard-ends-every-collecting-errand-whatever-the-number.md)** (confirmed, supply): Any line from cargo about a lost crate or a wrong number ends every crate errand a collector has asked for in the last minute, whatever crate it was about
   - Fix: In pickupsOverhear act only on the collect task whose number the line names, have cargo's no-such-crate line carry the number asked for, and take a numberless one only when said to this body with no other collector asking since
110. **[TRA-06](findings/TRA-06-janitor-asks-the-captain-for-supplies-instead-of-its-head.md)** (confirmed, supply): A janitor short of supplies with the Captain in sight asks the Captain to their face, not its head, and then waits eight minutes before it tells its head
   - Fix: In needStep ask the head of the body's own department, in view or by PDA, and treat the Captain as the one to ask only when the department has no head aboard
111. **[TRB-01](findings/TRB-01-wanted-person-cuffed-by-the-captain-is-never-taken-in.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone wanted whom the Captain or any player has cuffed is left standing in cuffs, the warrant never served and nobody told
   - Fix: Have people_in_view say who is pulling each person, and in serveStep leave a cuffed person to someone else only while another is pulling them, otherwise take them by the arm with how quiet, which the server already handles
112. **[TRB-02](findings/TRB-02-pardon-while-the-cuffs-are-going-on-leaves-them-held-for-good.md)** (confirmed, security): A pardon or a withdrawn warrant that comes while the cuffs are going on leaves the person cuffed and held by the arm for the rest of the round
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing, when an arrest comes back with the cuffs on and its warrant was dropped while it ran, push a let-go for that person; any net in syncBeat only for someone it holds cuffed whom no list it keeps has a warrant on
113. **[TRB-05](findings/TRB-05-wanted-person-sitting-in-a-chair-is-cuffed-and-left-in-it.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone wanted who is sitting in a chair or lying in a bed is cuffed, the walk to the brig leaves them behind, and they are reported lost, sat in cuffs where nobody will report them
   - Fix: In hold_arrested unbuckle a buckled prisoner by an empty-hand click on what they are buckled to, as a player does, before the hold is taken, and answer no_hold if they are still buckled
114. **[TRB-07](findings/TRB-07-crew-prisoner-is-told-it-is-free-the-moment-its-cuffs-come-off-in-the-cell.md)** (confirmed, security): A crew prisoner is set free the moment its cuffs come off inside the cell, before the officer is out and the timer started, because the arrest grace is counted from the start of the arrest
   - Fix: In custody_tick count the no-cuffs no-hand grace from held_at alone, not from arrested_at, and set held_at in being_arrested's early return, so the prisoner stays held for the seconds between uncuffing and the timer
115. **[TRB-08](findings/TRB-08-a-cell-whose-door-is-smashed-is-still-picked-and-the-prisoner-reported-jailed.md)** (confirmed, security): A cell whose glass door has been smashed is still picked first, the prisoner is shut in a cell that cannot shut, and is reported jailed
   - Fix: In free_cell pass over a cell whose door() is null, and at the top of put_in_cell answer no_way with cell_refuses when the door is gone, before anyone walks in
116. **[TRB-09](findings/TRB-09-why-a-warrant-cannot-be-served-is-told-once-a-round-per-person-never-again.md)** (confirmed, security): Why a warrant cannot be served is told once a round for each person, so on a second warrant on the same person nobody hears it and engineering is never asked to force the door again
   - Fix: Clear the cannotTold keys for a name when its warrant leaves beat.warrants (jailed, dropped, handed back), and let a key be told again after a few minutes while the warrant still stands
117. **[TRC-03](findings/TRC-03-any-pda-naming-a-meeting-in-a-room-is-a-call-to-it.md)** (confirmed, head): Any PDA message from the Captain or a head with meeting in the and a room in it is taken as a call to a meeting there, and the NPC drops its work and waits in that room seven minutes
   - Fix: In readSummons take a call only in the words a head calls by (Staff meeting in the X now) and take meeting is over only from a summons already standing from that sender
118. **[TRUST-07](findings/TRUST-07-quartermaster-takes-any-cargo-workers-word-that-an-order-failed-or-a-crate-is-lost.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): The Quartermaster takes "order N did not go through" and "crate N is lost" from anyone in a cargo job, and places the order again or buys the crate again
   - Fix: Take did-not-go-through only from the technician the order was given to, and put a big reorder from a lost line to the Captain instead of carrying the old approval over
119. **[ARR-08](findings/ARR-08-older-warrant-coming-into-sight-breaks-off-an-arrest-under-way.md)** (confirmed, security): With two warrants, the person on the older one coming into sight breaks off an arrest of the other that is under way
   - Fix: In orderToDrop do not drop a step of one emergency task for another emergency task, and have serveStep make the other warrant wait while an arrest is in hand
120. **[ARR-13](findings/ARR-13-warrant-handed-back-mid-arrest-leaves-the-head-of-security-holding-them.md)** (confirmed, security): A warrant the Head of Security hands back while its own arrest is under way leaves it holding the prisoner on no warrant, and the officer leaves them to it
   - Fix: In handBack keep a warrant whose arrest is under way as well as one whose person is held, and in beatAfterActing take back a warrant the desk still lists when an arrest comes back with the cuffs on
121. **[BRAIN-11](findings/BRAIN-11-order-reader-samples-at-talk-temperature-and-minutes-go-unchecked.md)** (confirmed, brain): The reader of last resort for orders is sampled at the talking temperature, so one message can read as a warrant one time and neither the next, and its minutes are never checked against the message
   - Fix: Give callOllama a temperature argument and pass 0 for readOrder, and read the minutes from the message with MINUTES_SAID instead of taking the model's number
122. **[CORE-07](findings/CORE-07-slow-tool-finishes-over-a-newer-tool-call.md)** (confirmed, core): A tool that takes time to choose (explore, force_door, go_to_door) starts its walk when it is done even if a newer tool call came in meanwhile, and the newer one is lost without a word
   - Fix: Count accepted tool calls on the controller, have each slow tool note the count when it starts and, when it is done choosing, drop its walk and say nothing if the count has moved on
123. **[DESK-02](findings/DESK-02-second-call-to-a-locked-room-is-given-up-before-the-janitor-sets-off.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Once a janitor has been let into a room, its next call to that room is given up as nobody let you in before it sets off
   - Fix: In syncTasks delete brain.letInAsks for the room the janitor stands in and for any door no open via mess task asks at, so each new call starts with a knock
124. **[DESK-10](findings/DESK-10-mop-and-soap-in-hand-with-a-bucket-known-it-never-sets-off-for-a-mess.md)** (confirmed, janitor): With a mop in one hand and soap or a spray in the other, a janitor that knows of a bucket tries to pick it up before every mess elsewhere, fails, and never sets off
   - Fix: Take the go-for-a-bucket step only when a hand is free or the other hand holds a rag, and after a failed try at the bucket stop offering it for that task
125. **[DOOR-06](findings/DOOR-06-door-out-chosen-without-testing-the-way-to-it.md)** (confirmed, doors): The door out of a room is chosen without testing that the body can walk to it, so it makes for the same unreachable door every time
   - Fix: Test a route to the inside tile for a door out as is done for a door in, so a door out that cannot be walked to is passed over and the next one tried
126. **[ENG-06](findings/ENG-06-chief-takes-engine-words-from-the-engineers-chat-and-relight-skips-emitters-last.md)** (confirmed, engineering): The Chief Engineer takes "the engine is lit" or "the emitters are off" from anything its engineer says, and the relight that follows can switch the emitters on before the cooling is running
   - Fix: Take each of the engineer's set words only when the line begins with that whole fixed line (litLine(chief name) and so on; a remark may follow it), and let the engineer take a relight order only once the engine is lit, with RELIGHT not ready while lighting(engine)
127. **[HEAD-03](findings/HEAD-03-two-staff-with-one-first-name-break-the-meeting.md)** (confirmed, head): Two staff with the same first name both answer one call-on, the second is never given a turn, and the head repeats the call and then walks off with the meeting unclosed
   - Fix: In hearReport give a heard turn to anyone present who reports at a started meeting with no turn yet, and call on by full name when two of the staff share a first name
128. **[HEAD-06](findings/HEAD-06-head-that-cannot-reach-the-room-keeps-staff-waiting-seven-minutes.md)** (confirmed, head): A head that is shut in, or cannot get to the meeting room, still calls its meeting and keeps all its staff standing there for seven minutes
   - Fix: Call no meeting while the head is shut in, and once the gathering wait has run out with the head still not in place, end the meeting so its staff are told by PDA and send their reports
129. **[HEAD-07](findings/HEAD-07-a-name-and-report-in-any-head-line-is-a-call-on.md)** (confirmed, head): Any line from its head with a staff member's first name and the word report in it makes that one give its report, and the head then calls on it again and stands 45 seconds waiting for a report already given
   - Fix: Make the call-on needs pattern require "first, your report, please" and have staff take only "first, your report" as a call-on, and in hearReport give an early reporter a heard turn so nextTurn skips them
130. **[JOBS-04](findings/JOBS-04-freight-step-that-keeps-failing-keeps-the-technician-busy-for-good.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A freight step that cannot be done, such as mail with the bag full, is never set aside, so the technician counts as busy with freight for good and never tidies or looks round again
   - Fix: Pass ok and the reason to afterFreight, block a freight task whose step has failed three times running for a few minutes (retryAt as pickups does), and let SEND go while the mail task is blocked
131. **[KNB-14](findings/KNB-14-walks-tried-while-shut-in-write-off-the-room-it-was-going-to.md)** (confirmed, core): Walks tried while the body is shut in where it stands are counted against the room it was going to, so twice shut in writes that room off for fifteen minutes
   - Fix: In walk_finished do not mark blocked_places or blocked_tries for the goal when the walk failed because the body is shut in where it stands, and clear what was marked while shut in once it is out
132. **[LOGA-04](findings/LOGA-04-a-knock-a-workmate-answered-is-answered-again-a-minute-later-and-a-working-janitor-is-let-out.md)** (confirmed, logs): A knock that one technician has answered stays live for the other for a minute, so when the janitor is let back in it is let out again unasked and its scrub is cut short
   - Fix: Stamp each let-out per room on the department list in expected.ts and drop any knock on that room older than the stamp, and take a knock from inside only for someone let in before it
133. **[MAP-07](findings/MAP-07-crew-walk-normally-with-the-gravity-off.md)** (confirmed, core): With the station's gravity off a crew body can push off from nothing and set itself moving in open floor, which no player can do (after that the game's own drift carries it)
   - Fix: Give every crew step the check a player's step gets (no gravity and nothing to push off means no step), in an allowed_to_move override on the crew movement type and in the idle shuffle, and tell the brain the body is floating
134. **[MAP-11](findings/MAP-11-a-hole-in-the-floor-counts-as-a-safe-spot-to-stand.md)** (confirmed, core): A hole down to the floor below counts as a safe spot to stand, so on multi-floor maps a room's spot, its middle or a spawn tile can be open space, which no walk reaches and a body made there falls through
   - Fix: Make crew_npc_safe_turf refuse any tile the body could fall through, using the turf's own can_cross_safely, so every spot picker leaves holes out
135. **[MULTI-04](findings/MULTI-04-locker-a-workmate-has-open-is-remembered-as-empty-for-five-minutes.md)** (confirmed, hands): A locker that a workmate has open at that moment is taken for empty, and what it holds is struck from memory for five minutes, so janitors who search one closet together forget its mop and bucket
   - Fix: Read what lies on the tile of a locker found open as its contents and report it as looked, in look_inside and take_from_container
136. **[PERF-06](findings/PERF-06-mess-memory-fills-at-300-and-then-sees-no-new-mess.md)** (confirmed, senses): A body's mess memory stops taking new messes at 300 and keeps the dead ones for good, so after a tour of maintenance it never notes a new mess, and every look searches its sight once for each dead one
   - Fix: Test sight against a turf set built once per look, and at the cap forget the entry seen longest ago outside the work area so a new mess can be kept
137. **[SUP-04](findings/SUP-04-marked-squares-by-doors-and-on-conveyors.md)** (confirmed, supply): Any painted box on the bay floor is taken for a crate square, with no look at doors or conveyors, so on some maps crates are stood on the loading conveyor by the dock doors
   - Fix: Leave out of crew_npc_marked_squares any painted tile that has a conveyor on it or a door within one tile
138. **[SUP-15](findings/SUP-15-crate-boxed-in-on-the-squares-is-written-off-as-lost.md)** (confirmed, supply): A held crate that twice could not be reached is written off as lost for good, as its count is never set back, and on a map whose squares form a solid block the middle crates can be walled in
   - Fix: Set entry.unreachable back to 0 in do_errand whenever a held crate is reached, and on maps whose squares form a solid block let free_square skip a square that would wall a crate in
139. **[HOLE-25](findings/HOLE-25-the-voice-is-told-to-greet-a-corpse.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A dead or senseless body coming into view is put to the voice as someone new to greet, and the report never says that anyone in view is down, dead or in cuffs
   - Fix: Say in the arrival line and in People in view when someone is lying still, out cold, dead (as examining them would show) or cuffed, and do not wake the voice to greet anyone who is not up and awake
140. **[KNA-32](findings/KNA-32-officer-talks-of-its-warrant-aloud-the-rule-is-only-in-the-prompt.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): The officer talks about its warrant out loud to people it meets, because keeping it quiet is only a line in the prompt and no code screens what is said
   - Fix: In the reply filter in brain.ts, drop or replace a remark of a security body that names someone it holds a warrant on, unless it is said to security, the Captain or a head

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 94

141. **[ARR-01](findings/ARR-01-arrest-tries-held-back-by-driver-up-to-two-minutes.md)** (confirmed, security): Each failed try at an arrest is held back longer by the driver, up to two minutes, while the officer stands beside them
   - Fix: Number each try at an arrest as the tries at a cell are numbered, and say the arrest line again only when toldAt is null
142. **[ARR-04](findings/ARR-04-no-power-in-the-brig-reads-as-every-cell-in-use.md)** (confirmed, security): With the brig's power out every cell reads as in use, and the officer stands where it made the arrest holding its prisoner, telling nobody
   - Fix: Have tool_jail say no_power apart from no_cell, walk the prisoner to the brig to wait, and tell whoever keeps the list once
143. **[ARR-05](findings/ARR-05-word-for-head-of-security-stuck-on-a-pda-that-will-not-send.md)** (confirmed, security): Word for the Head of Security that has gone to the PDA once is never said to its face, so with PDAs down it is never told
   - Fix: In tellHead say the word face to face whenever the Head of Security is in sight, after a PDA send fails go to the post to find them, and have the desk take the same outcome only once
144. **[ARR-06](findings/ARR-06-door-opened-by-the-captain-is-not-walked-through.md)** (confirmed, security): The officer asks the Captain to let it in, and when the Captain opens the door it does not go through
   - Fix: Tell the brain when the door it is standing at is open, and have letInStep walk through it at once whoever opened it
145. **[ASYNC-05](findings/ASYNC-05-word-to-tell-struck-off-when-queued-and-lost-if-they-walk-off.md)** (confirmed, driver): Word meant for someone face to face is struck off the moment it is queued for the model, and is lost if they walk out of sight before it is said
   - Fix: Strike a spoken tell off toTell only once the line has gone out with its person still in view, not in noteDone when it is handed to the model; if they have gone, say nothing and leave it on toTell
146. **[BRAIN-02](findings/BRAIN-02-hung-model-freezes-every-body-with-a-line-to-say.md)** (confirmed, brain): A model that hangs, not one that is down, freezes each body with a line to say for 60 seconds times its place in the queue
   - Fix: Give a line the work calls for its own short wait, after which the plain line is said without the model, and give talk calls a shorter time limit
147. **[BRAIN-04](findings/BRAIN-04-line-the-server-refused-is-counted-as-said.md)** (confirmed, brain): A line the server refuses or throws away is counted as said, and the work goes on as if it had been heard
   - Fix: Read the server's refusal of a say in ingest and say the line again once, and keep the window's own count of tool calls so the server's limit is never reached
148. **[CARGO-03](findings/CARGO-03-did-not-go-through-is-said-once-and-not-confirmed.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Word that an order did not go through is said once, only if the Quartermaster is in sight within two minutes, and nothing checks it was heard
   - Fix: Pass the did-not-go-through word through tellQuartermaster as a task of its own, with the same I-have-that answer and PDA fall-back as the other three words
149. **[CARGO-04](findings/CARGO-04-server-refuses-to-open-the-door-for-security.md)** (confirmed, doors): A technician goes to let security in and the server refuses, because open_door lets in nobody but a janitor with a mess to clean
   - Fix: Let tool_open_door (and the simulator's copy of it) open for someone in security who is at the door, and give doorCue words for security that do not talk of a mess
150. **[CARGO-05](findings/CARGO-05-crate-count-read-only-right-before-the-word-crate.md)** (confirmed, cargo): How many crates is read only when the number stands right before the word crate, so two janitorial crates is one crate, and five is one
   - Fix: Read the count from any number in the same clause as the kind (digits, one to ten, a couple, x2), and cap it at the server's four instead of falling back to one
151. **[CARGO-18](findings/CARGO-18-sent-to-see-to-a-crate-that-would-not-go-out-to-the-lobby-it-does-nothing.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A technician the Quartermaster sends to see to a crate that would not go out to the lobby is given nothing to do about it, and the one who failed tries again alone
   - Fix: When the see-to line names a held crate that would not go out to the lobby, have the technician sent take a hand-over task for that number, and have the one who failed drop its own
152. **[CHEAT-02](findings/CHEAT-02-who-can-open-a-door-read-off-everyones-id-card.md)** (confirmed, core): Who to ask to open a door is found by reading every crew member's ID card and the place of their PDA, from anywhere
   - Fix: Go by the name and job the PDA's contact list shows and the access that job's ID trim gives, not by the card each person carries or where their PDA is
153. **[CHEAT-03](findings/CHEAT-03-free-cell-picked-from-anywhere-by-reading-every-cell.md)** (confirmed, security): An officer picks a free brig cell from wherever it makes the arrest, by reading every cell's timer and who is inside, unseen
   - Fix: In tool_jail pick only among cells in view, else walk to the first cell, and in put_in_cell pick again among the cells in view on arrival before answering every cell is in use
154. **[CHEAT-04](findings/CHEAT-04-arrest-told-to-prisoner-by-a-call-and-officer-knows-who-is-an-npc.md)** (confirmed, security): A crew prisoner is told it is being arrested by a direct call before anything is said or done, and the officer treats it apart because it knows it is an NPC
   - Fix: Let the prisoner learn of its arrest from the words it hears and the cuffs and hand it feels, and have the officer judge who stood for it by what they did, not by whether they have a crew controller
155. **[CHEAT-11](findings/CHEAT-11-air-in-rooms-out-of-sight-is-known.md)** (confirmed, senses): A body knows the air pressure on tiles it cannot see, behind shut doors and in rooms it has never entered, and steers by it
   - Fix: Test the air only on tiles the body stands on or can see, and judge unseen rooms by what shows from outside - shut fire doors, a door's pressure warning, an alarm in view
156. **[CHEAT-12](findings/CHEAT-12-crate-order-numbers-read-off-manifests-nobody-tore-off.md)** (confirmed, cargo): When the shuttle docks, the technician knows which crate is which order by reading the number off every attached manifest, aboard and in the bay, without touching one
   - Fix: Learn a crate's number by tearing its manifest off with a click and reading it, one crate at a time as each is unloaded, and only then hold and label it
157. **[CHEAT-15](findings/CHEAT-15-crew-see-everything-in-pitch-darkness.md)** (confirmed, senses): Crew bodies see people, messes and things in pitch darkness, because view() in this codebase ignores light and nothing else checks it
   - Fix: Build a set of lit turfs once per look (turf.check_lumcount_above(LIGHTING_TILE_IS_DARK)) and keep from each sight list only what stands on a lit turf or next to the body, unless the body has night vision
158. **[CORE-02](findings/CORE-02-stunned-body-hears-nothing-and-pda-messages-are-lost.md)** (confirmed, core): A body that is stunned or paralysed for a moment is treated as senseless, so what is said to it is not heard and a PDA message that comes in then is lost for good
   - Fix: Make can_sense depend on the body (alive, conscious, no player in it), not on ai_status; add can_act for doing things and for the window's awake; keep PDA messages that come while it cannot sense to read when it can
159. **[CORE-03](findings/CORE-03-walk-follows-a-person-out-of-sight-with-perfect-knowledge.md)** (confirmed, core): A body walking up to someone follows them wherever they go, out of sight and through rooms, for 30 seconds, and an officer chases a suspect the same way for 3 minutes
   - Fix: In the walk and reach leaves, when the target is a mob, read last_seen_at each tick, and once it is a few seconds old end the leaf with they went out of sight and walk to the turf they were last seen on
160. **[DOOR-02](findings/DOOR-02-locked-out-of-ignores-open-ways-in.md)** (confirmed, doors): A room with an open way in (shutters up, a gap with no door) is still taken as locked to the body
   - Fix: Have locked_out_of answer FALSE for a room with an open doorless way in from a hallway or a room open to the body, using the open-way test of crew_npc_room_is_closed with the DOOR-09 correction, kept for a minute per room
161. **[DOOR-07](findings/DOOR-07-door-reported-open-when-only-the-engineer-can-open-it.md)** (confirmed, doors): An engineer sent to open a door for someone else reports it open when it only opens to the engineer, or was open for a moment
   - Fix: In tool_force_door and force_door_open force a door that opens to the engineer's own ID like any other, count an open door only if it will stay open, and test the way round with no ID, so that "open" is only answered when anyone can walk in
162. **[DOOR-12](findings/DOOR-12-forced-door-reported-open-with-a-fire-door-shut-under-it.md)** (confirmed, doors): A door is reported forced open, or standing open, while a shut fire door on the same square still bars the way
   - Fix: Before answering that a door is open, look for a shut fire door on the airlock's square and answer it as fire doors, with the fire_doors detail fire_door_report gives
163. **[DOOR-14](findings/DOOR-14-door-that-will-not-open-gives-no-reason.md)** (confirmed, doors): A door a technician cannot open is answered with one line for four causes, so a door with no power is walked to at every asking and nobody is told why
   - Fix: Give hold_door_for a separate answer and a reason detail for no power, bolted, welded and not your access, refuse a door that stands open only when it is not open, and pass over dead doors in room_door_for
164. **[DOOR-15](findings/DOOR-15-electrified-door-shocks-the-chief-engineer-and-is-reported-as-a-wire-fault.md)** (confirmed, doors): An electrified door shocks a body without insulated gloves, the Chief Engineer always, as it goes for the wires, and the brain is told only that a wire would not pulse, so it goes back for a second shock
   - Fix: Watch for the body being shocked at the door (COMSIG_LIVING_ELECTROCUTE_ACT) and answer reason electrified, which forcing.ts takes as final, and check for insulated gloves before going into the wires of a door that has shocked it
165. **[DRV-07](findings/DRV-07-shut-in-asks-counted-when-queued-and-never-made-again.md)** (confirmed, driver): Shut in, a person counts as asked for the door the moment the line is queued, and nobody is asked or knocked for a second time in that stay
   - Fix: Mark a helper as asked only when the line is really said, and let an ask and a knock be made again after a couple of minutes with nobody come
166. **[DRV-12](findings/DRV-12-work-held-back-sends-the-body-exploring-and-straight-back.md)** (confirmed, driver): While a step of its work is held back the body goes exploring or to other work, and the walk back is let off before the step is, so it walks away and back every few seconds
   - Fix: Offer no idle explore while work is only held back, and hold back any walk to a place where a step has just failed until that step is let off
167. **[ENG-03](findings/ENG-03-emitters-off-order-goes-to-whichever-engineer-is-first-on-the-pda.md)** (confirmed, engineering): The emitters-off order, and every other engineering order, goes to whichever engineer is first in sight or on the PDA list, a player or a dead one included, not to the one that lit the engine
   - Fix: Have the Chief Engineer remember which engineer took the engine (and each door job) and give later orders to that one, and fall back to another only after the first has not answered twice, preferring one that has spoken the crew's set words before
168. **[HAND-02](findings/HAND-02-mess-it-could-not-walk-to-is-written-off-for-the-round.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A mess the body could not walk to once is put with those that will not come off, for the rest of the round, and it says its mop will not shift it
   - Fix: Keep messes it could not get to in a list of their own with the time, try them again after a few minutes, and tell the brain could not get to it apart from would not come off
169. **[HAND-04](findings/HAND-04-pick-up-goes-for-a-thing-in-sight-it-cannot-get-to-every-time.md)** (confirmed, hands): Pick up goes for the nearest thing of that name in sight even when it cannot be got to, every time, and never for the closet it knows holds one
   - Fix: Keep a short list of things pick up could not get to, with the time, skip them in tool_pick_up for a few minutes, and fall through to the remembered container; and leave them out of things_in_view so the window stops offering them
170. **[HAND-05](findings/HAND-05-pick-up-goes-back-to-a-locker-it-found-locked-for-good.md)** (confirmed, hands): A locker found locked or welded on a fetch is still remembered as holding the thing, so every later pick up walks back to it and fails, and the janitor never asks for supplies
   - Fix: In tool_pick_up skip a container whose last look found it shut to the body, and in the window leave a locked container's items out of allKnownItems
171. **[HAND-08](findings/HAND-08-errand-one-tile-off-through-a-wall-or-window-counts-as-arrived.md)** (confirmed, hands): An errand target one tile off across a windoor, a thin window or a wall corner counts as reached at once, so the body gives up on it without a step, every time
   - Fix: In crew_npc_reach count arrival only when can_reach_target_now is true, and when get_dist is within reach but a wall or window is between, walk to an open tile beside the target from which it can be reached
172. **[HEAD-01](findings/HEAD-01-empty-cargo-counter-stops-every-later-meeting.md)** (confirmed, head): An order the Head of Personnel cannot get anyone at the counter to take stops every later staff meeting, the Captain's own included
   - Fix: Hold meetings back only while the head is at the counter waiting for an answer (in syncMeeting and in toSee), park an order nobody at the counter takes until after the next meeting and tell the Captain once, and pass over a technician who is down
173. **[HEAD-02](findings/HEAD-02-lost-crate-leaves-the-asker-never-ordered-for-again.md)** (confirmed, head): A crate that is lost, or never unpacked, leaves whoever asked for it noted as ordered for good, so the Head of Personnel never orders for them again
   - Fix: Read Lost at cargo in the head's readsMessage, drop that crate's pickup and set its askers back to not ordered unless cargo is reordering it, drop the pickup on the no-such-crate word, and give an ordered and untold ask an age limit after which it is dropped
174. **[HEAD-05](findings/HEAD-05-order-to-quartermaster-retried-for-ever-when-pda-will-not-send.md)** (confirmed, head): When its PDA will not send, the Head of Personnel's order to the Quartermaster is tried again for ever and never taken to the counter, and no staff meeting is held meanwhile
   - Fix: Note the first try to send the order whether or not it went, stop offering the same message, take a Noted that comes after the server resends it, and go to the counter once the server has stopped resending (about nine minutes)
