175. **[HOLE-18](findings/HOLE-18-a-hand-that-is-lost-or-disabled-is-counted-as-free.md)** (confirmed, hands): A hand that is lost or disabled is counted as a free hand, so a one-handed body walks to every thing it is sent for and fails to pick it up, for good
   - Fix: Count a hand as free only when has_hand_for_held_index says it works, in one helper used by every free-hand test, put things into that working hand by its index, and tell the brain when a hand stops working
176. **[JAN-03](findings/JAN-03-filthy-rag-still-counted-as-a-tool-and-never-washed.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A rag grows filthy with blood and then cleans nothing, but is still counted as a tool, so every mess after is written off and the rag is never rinsed at a sink
   - Fix: Count a rag with blood_level 10 or more as a spent tool in can_clean_with, and add a step that rinses it at a sink in sight the way a player does, by a plain click with the rag
177. **[JAN-13](findings/JAN-13-mess-cleaned-by-someone-else-turns-room-into-one-beyond-its-mop.md)** (confirmed, cleaning): A mess someone else cleaned up, out of the janitor's sight, makes the room one its mop will not shift, and the room is left unvisited with the old mess still on its list
   - Fix: Make workable_mess_places judge a remembered mess by what was seen of it (its kind, kept in the memory entry), not by whether it still exists, and let the body walk to the spot of a remembered mess that no longer resolves so it can look
178. **[JOBS-05](findings/JOBS-05-everyone-aboard-knows-from-anywhere-which-crates-are-out-in-the-lobby.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Every body aboard is told from anywhere which crates cargo has put out in the lobby and who took them, and a collector sets off for its crate before it has seen it
   - Fix: Only act on a crate being out when the body is in the room the crate is in (brain.location equals the crate's place), and on the server send out crates to non-cargo bodies only when they are in that room
179. **[KNA-02](findings/KNA-02-shut-in-body-leaves-the-door-it-waits-at.md)** (confirmed, driver): A body shut in and waiting at the door is sent off to search storage and to walk to rooms it cannot reach
   - Fix: While shut in with no open door in view, offer only steps that keep the body where it is, and make the meeting step wait instead of walking
180. **[KNA-09](findings/KNA-09-warrant-held-by-an-officer-who-is-down-is-never-served.md)** (confirmed, security): A warrant given to an officer who then goes down or falls silent is never served by anyone
   - Fix: Have whoever keeps the list take the warrants back when it sees its officer lying on the floor, or when the officer does not answer a fixed "any word on X" sent after some minutes of silence
181. **[KNA-19](findings/KNA-19-room-in-parts-one-door-opens-so-whole-room-is-taken-for-open.md)** (confirmed, doors): A room split by inner locked doors counts as open if one outer door opens, so janitors set off for a part of it they cannot reach (the Research Division, no route)
   - Fix: Work out which part of a room the body can get into from the doors that open for it, and pick the spot to walk to, and the messes that are its to clean, from that part only
182. **[KNA-23](findings/KNA-23-officer-looks-for-someone-by-standing-at-the-first-spot-of-the-room.md)** (confirmed, security): The officer looks for someone by standing for 20 seconds at the first spot it reaches in the room, so in a room wider than its sight it does not see them
   - Fix: After the first look from the arrival spot, walk to the middle of the room (go_to with middle, which exists) and look again before the room is counted as looked in, with a far-end leg later if the middle is not enough
183. **[KNA-26](findings/KNA-26-officer-asks-to-be-let-in-only-by-pda-never-to-a-keeper-in-sight.md)** (confirmed, security): Shut out, the officer asks to be let in only by PDA, in a fixed order, never to the face of a keeper it can see, and with no PDA it gives up at once
   - Fix: Ask first whichever keeper is in sight, aloud, and fall back to the PDA list only when none is, and with no PDA wait at the door for a keeper to come by
184. **[KNA-28](findings/KNA-28-no-way-out-of-the-closet-is-a-sealed-maintenance-pocket-then-an-empty-shut-in-test.md)** (confirmed, doors): The "no way out" of the Custodial Closet at round start is a walk to a sealed corner of the maintenance next door, followed by a shut-in test that tests nothing
   - Fix: Pick the spot to walk to in a room only from the squares joined by floor to a door the body can open, and do not count shut in from a test that tried no route
185. **[KNB-09](findings/KNB-09-aloud-heads-ignore-on-my-way-and-reports-by-pda.md)** (confirmed, head): The Quartermaster and the Chief Engineer call absent staff to a meeting by PDA but read neither the On my way back nor a report sent by PDA, and never tell them it is over
   - Fix: Move the reading of On my way and of a report by PDA out of the Head of Personnel's readsMessage into one helper every head calls, and send the meeting-is-over word to anyone who was called by PDA
186. **[KNB-15](findings/KNB-15-crate-would-not-come-word-is-dropped-when-the-quartermaster-is-not-found.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Word that a crate would not come is dropped without a trace when the Quartermaster is not found, and a technician who cannot reach its office door holds it five minutes for nothing
   - Fix: When tellQuartermaster gives up on a would-not-come word, send the same line to the Quartermaster by PDA and have its readsMessage pass a technician's WONT_COME_WORDS to crateHeldUp
187. **[LOGA-07](findings/LOGA-07-model-takes-on-a-call-the-janitor-code-has-just-turned-down.md)** (confirmed, logs): A call the janitor's code has just turned down (needs soap or a rag, and it has neither) is taken on all the same when the model answers work, and the janitor sets off for a locked room it cannot get into
   - Fix: Note the room of a call the janitor turned down, and have takeToldWork refuse a CLEAN task for that room from the model until the janitor holds something that scrubs
188. **[LOGB-02](findings/LOGB-02-meeting-call-mid-haul-loses-the-unpacked-crate.md)** (confirmed, driver): A meeting called while a janitor hauls a collected crate makes its brain lose the haul, so it unpacks the crate, then tells its head the crate is lost
   - Fix: Do not let a step that stays put (a PDA reply) take the place of brain.lastAct while a walk or haul is still waiting on its result, keep it aside and match results to either
189. **[LOGB-03](findings/LOGB-03-door-opened-for-another-janitor-is-booked-to-the-one-named.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A door the server opens for some other janitor is booked by the brain as opened for the one it named, who is then let out of a room they were never in for good
   - Fix: Send back who the door was opened for (and which way) in the open_door result details, carried through finish_errand, and have afterActing book that person, not task.item, leaving the named person's call untouched when the two differ
190. **[LOGB-05](findings/LOGB-05-shut-in-janitor-learns-the-public-cargo-lobby-is-locked-and-keeps-it.md)** (confirmed, doors): A janitor shut in a room learns that the Cargo Lobby and the Cargo Bay each open only from the other, keeps that for good, and makes for the door of the public lobby
   - Fix: Send door_through from go_to_door only when a route to the outer room's own door was found, never from a body that is shut in, and have the brain refuse an entry that makes a loop and forget entries after a while
191. **[LOGB-06](findings/LOGB-06-janitor-at-a-cargo-door-writes-only-to-the-caller-even-in-cuffs.md)** (confirmed, janitor): A janitor waiting at a cargo door writes only to the technician who called it, eight times in thirteen minutes while that technician was in cuffs, and never to the other one
   - Fix: When word to the caller brings nobody, write in turn to others whose ID opens that door (room_keepers, as officers get) and then its own head, once each, and never write twice to one person for that door
192. **[MEM-01](findings/MEM-01-any-word-of-its-name-or-job-anywhere-is-taken-as-said-to-it.md)** (confirmed, memory): Any word of an NPC's name or job anywhere in a line is taken as said to it
   - Fix: In saidTo rule 1 test that the line calls on the NPC (first or last name, or its whole job title, at the start, set off by a comma, or as the last word) instead of usesName, and drop the loose test
193. **[MEM-04](findings/MEM-04-of-two-rooms-named-the-longest-name-wins-not-the-one-meant.md)** (confirmed, memory): Of two rooms named in one line the longest name is taken, not the one meant, so orders go to the wrong room
   - Fix: In placeNamedIn drop matches that lie inside a longer match, then take the first room named that is not set aside by not, forget, leave, instead of or from, falling back to the first match if all are set aside
194. **[MEM-07](findings/MEM-07-told-of-a-mess-in-the-room-it-stands-in-but-out-of-sight-it-takes-nothing-on.md)** (confirmed, memory): Told of a mess in the room it is standing in but cannot see from where it stands, a janitor takes nothing on, even from its head
   - Fix: Drop the early return in takeToldWork for the room it stands in, but only together with DESK-08's look-round, or the task closes at once and the janitor tells its head the mess is cleaned up
195. **[MEM-08](findings/MEM-08-any-mention-of-check-or-look-and-a-room-by-a-superior-is-an-order-to-go-and-look.md)** (confirmed, memory): Any line from a superior with check, look or see if in it and a room named is an order to drop everything and go and look
   - Fix: Make out a look order by code only when the look word is said to the NPC as a request with the room as its object, and leave everything else to the model's work answer
196. **[MULTI-01](findings/MULTI-01-with-two-officers-sightings-and-let-go-go-to-whichever-is-in-sight.md)** (confirmed, security): With a Head of Security and two officers, sightings, let-go orders and repeat gives go to whichever officer is in sight, not to the one holding the warrant
   - Fix: Record on each desk warrant the officer it was given to, and send that warrant's sightings, let-go and re-gives to that officer only, choosing a new one only when the holder is down, hurt or gone
197. **[MULTI-06](findings/MULTI-06-a-mail-notice-to-a-janitor-counts-as-a-janitor-called-and-holds-the-workmate-back-ten-minutes.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Any PDA message a technician sends a janitor, a mail notice among them, counts as the post having called a janitor, and holds its workmate's calls to every mess back for ten minutes
   - Fix: Note a janitor call only for a message that is a call to a mess (have the window say so in the tool call), keep the room it was for, and let a workmate's call hold back only a call to that room
198. **[PARSE-14](findings/PARSE-14-josh-reed-come-here-is-taken-by-josh-kim-too.md)** (confirmed, brain): Josh Reed, come here is taken by Josh Kim as said to him, so a full name used to tell two crew apart does not, and Al, open the door is said to nobody
   - Fix: In saidTo, before rule 1, find the longest known full name the line calls on, and if it is someone else's the line is theirs, else cut full names out before rules 1 and 2; and let a first name of one or two letters be called on when it stands at the start or is set off by a comma
199. **[PARSE-15](findings/PARSE-15-meeting-order-words-miss-plain-asks-and-take-questions.md)** (confirmed, head): Status report on your department and gather your staff call no meeting, while did you hold a meeting and get the bar cleaned, no need for a meeting each call one, the second dropping the order
   - Fix: Refuse MEETING_ORDER_WORDS in a question or after a negation, add the plain asks for a report and for gathering staff, and test it per clause so an order in another clause still stands
200. **[PARSE-16](findings/PARSE-16-quartermaster-hop-janitor-said-first-call-on-nobody.md)** (confirmed, brain): Quartermaster, order some paper and Janitor, clean the bar call on nobody when anyone else is about, because only crew with a post are known by their job, and HoP, QM, CE, HoS and sec never
   - Fix: Let any crew member be called on by its job title or the usual shorthand for it, in callsOn's strict shapes (at the start, or set off by a comma), longest title first so Engineer is not taken from Chief Engineer
201. **[PARSE-17](findings/PARSE-17-someone-threw-up-in-the-bar-is-put-to-the-group.md)** (confirmed, brain): Someone threw up in the bar, said to a janitor's face, is taken as put to everyone there, and only the nearest crew member answers, who may not be the janitor
   - Fix: Let a job's soundsLike words make its task from a line said to the group or to nobody, as overhears does for other jobs, so the one whose work it is takes it whoever answers; and count someone, anyone and the like as group words only when they are the one asked
202. **[PERF-08](findings/PERF-08-ui-data-works-out-the-same-things-many-times-per-body-per-update.md)** (confirmed, core): ui_data works out the same things over and over for every body on every update - four walks of up to 300 remembered messes, two or three of every PDA, a fresh view for security and engineering, about ten ID card lookups
   - Fix: Work out each body's sense-derived fields once per look into a snapshot list on the controller, have ui_data copy the snapshot and add only the cheap live fields, and pass the look's sight list to security_state and engineering_state
203. **[QM-02](findings/QM-02-order-given-again-for-good-to-a-technician-who-never-answers.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): An order is given to a technician who is down, dead or a human player, and given to the same one again every minute for the rest of the round
   - Fix: Leave out technicians who are down or cuffed when picking, count how often an order has gone unanswered and after two give it to another free technician, and take a plain ok from the technician it was given to as taken
204. **[QM-03](findings/QM-03-two-technicians-with-one-first-name.md)** (confirmed, quartermaster): Two technicians with one first name both place every order given to either, and the meeting deals out their work for ever and never closes
   - Fix: Address a technician by first name only when no other technician aboard shares it, else by full name, and read the full name back on both sides
205. **[RT-02](findings/RT-02-errand-target-deleted-on-the-way-never-reported.md)** (confirmed, core): An errand whose target is deleted while the body is still walking to it ends without a word to the brain
   - Fix: Override sig_remove_from_blackboard on the crew controller so that a lost errand or storage target is closed off and reported a moment later
206. **[SEC-07](findings/SEC-07-cuff-tries-burned-then-free-to-go-in-cuffs.md)** (confirmed, security): A crew member left in cuffs burns its three tries in three seconds, is told it is free to go, and works the rest of the shift in handcuffs
   - Fix: Count a try only when the cuff do_after really started, never end custody while the cuffs are on, and keep trying as a player would (asking for help is a later step for the owner)
207. **[SECT-10](findings/SECT-10-thanks-or-a-question-by-pda-gets-i-did-not-follow-that.md)** (confirmed, security): Any PDA message from the Captain or a head to security that is not an order, such as thanks or a question, is answered I did not follow that with the warrant wording
   - Fix: Send not followed only when the model gave no answer and the message has an order word in it, or the reading was a warrant or pardon that did not take; when the model says neither, send nothing or hand it to the voice
208. **[SENSE-06](findings/SENSE-06-walking-onto-a-known-peel-or-soap-still-slips.md)** (confirmed, senses): A body that knows a banana peel, soap or foam lies ahead slows to a walk and steps on it anyway, and walking does not stop those from slipping anyone
   - Fix: Walk only for a slippery thing whose lube_flags hold NO_SLIP_WHEN_WALKING, and for the rest refuse the step and go round the tile (or pick the thing up), the owner to choose
209. **[SENSE-08](findings/SENSE-08-captain-or-head-without-a-worn-id-can-be-walked-out.md)** (confirmed, senses): The Captain or a head of staff who is not wearing their ID is a stranger to every keeper of a room, and can be taken by the arm and walked out
   - Fix: Have why_not_put_out and the command flag in look_around also count anyone whose own face shows and whose name the crew manifest gives as the Captain or a head, and have the window treat a name its PDA list shows as Captain or a head as command
210. **[SUP-06](findings/SUP-06-haul-broken-off-by-a-new-order-never-lets-go.md)** (confirmed, supply): A body sent somewhere else in the middle of a haul keeps dragging the crate, and a crate being collected stays "being taken away" for good
   - Fix: Have start_walk and start_errand end a haul or a walk out they replace - let go, clear collected_by or call put_out, tell the brain - and let a collected_by claim or an in_hand hold lapse when nobody is pulling
211. **[SUP-09](findings/SUP-09-crate-contents-that-are-not-items-do-not-count.md)** (confirmed, supply): Only small items count as what a crate holds, so a crate with a filing cabinet or a janitorial cart in it is called empty, "unpacked" with the thing still inside, and sent back to be sold
   - Fix: Count everything a crate holds, not only /obj/item, and unpack by opening the crate so that what cannot be lifted comes out too
212. **[SUP-11](findings/SUP-11-budget-check-ignores-the-cart-and-an-unpaid-order-flies-the-shuttle-in-circles.md)** (confirmed, supply): The budget check before an order leaves out what is already in the cart, and an order the shuttle cannot pay for flies the shuttle to and fro for six minutes and is then called held up
   - Fix: Count the cost of every order already in SSshuttle.shopping_list against the budget in tool_order, and in supply_run_step tell an order that came back unbought for want of money from one held up, and say so
213. **[SUP-12](findings/SUP-12-crate-put-aboard-to-be-sold-is-hauled-back-off.md)** (confirmed, supply): A crate a player puts aboard the docked supply shuttle to be sold is taken for one that came in on it, hauled off into the bay, and stops the shuttle leaving until it is
   - Fix: Note which crates are aboard when the shuttle docks at the station and unload only those, so a crate put aboard afterwards goes out with the shuttle
214. **[SUP-17](findings/SUP-17-held-crate-a-player-takes-and-unpacks-is-written-off-as-lost.md)** (confirmed, supply): A held crate that a player takes away and unpacks, the one who ordered it among them, is written off as lost and emptied, and its owner is told so and may have it bought again
   - Fix: Treat a held crate seen leaving cargo's rooms in the hands of someone who is not crew as taken, not lost, and call one emptied lost only in cargo's own rooms - the owner must agree first, as the secure-areas plan lists both as lost
215. **[TRA-02](findings/TRA-02-head-asking-again-at-the-counter-is-sold-a-second-crate.md)** (confirmed, supply): A head who asks again at the counter is ordered a second crate though cargo is already holding one for it, and the head cannot hear a spoken word that its crate is in
   - Fix: At the counter, answer a head's order with the number of any crate already held for it in a fixed line and offer no order for that kind, and have the head read that line, and an overheard has-come-in, the same as the PDA message
216. **[TRA-04](findings/TRA-04-any-word-from-cargo-in-earshot-counts-as-the-order-taken.md)** (confirmed, supply): At the counter, anything any cargo worker says in the head's hearing counts as its order being taken, so an order nobody took is not asked again for ten minutes
   - Fix: Have the technician who places a head's order say a fixed line naming the head and what was ordered, and count only that line, said to the head, as the order taken
217. **[TRA-08](findings/TRA-08-second-asker-gets-a-new-crate-though-the-one-coming-has-room.md)** (confirmed, supply): Someone who asks while an order is on its way gets a crate of their own ordered, though the crate coming holds enough for them, and is then served from the first crate anyway
   - Fix: Count an order in hand as good for count times PER_CRATE people and put a later asker on it while there is room, ordering afresh only for those it cannot cover
218. **[TRB-06](findings/TRB-06-someone-out-of-their-cell-early-is-not-seen-by-the-officer-until-the-term-ends.md)** (confirmed, security): Someone who gets out of their cell before their time, let out by a player or breaking out, is not seen by the officer until the term would have ended, even on a new warrant
   - Fix: In inCells count a name from beat.jailed only while that person is not in view outside a running cell, and drop the jailed and held entries when they are seen out
219. **[TRB-11](findings/TRB-11-pardon-of-someone-in-a-cell-goes-only-to-the-officer-who-put-them-there.md)** (confirmed, security): A pardon for someone in a cell is passed only to the officer, so with the officer down or gone nobody opens the cell, though the Captain is told at once that it is done
   - Fix: When the desk strikes someone it knows to be in a cell, have whoever keeps the list free them itself if the officer does not say they are free in a minute or two, going to the brig and stopping the cell it was told of
220. **[TRC-04](findings/TRC-04-two-failed-walks-to-an-engine-machine-stop-the-lighting-for-good-with-the-wrong-reason.md)** (confirmed, engineering): Two lighting steps that fail for any reason, a blocked walk or a full hand included, stop the lighting for good, and the Chief Engineer and the Captain are told the machine will not take
   - Fix: Pass the server's reason for a failed work_machine to the brain, count towards the stop only a machine that would not take, retry a walk or hand failure after a back-off, and say the true reason when it does stop
221. **[TRUST-04](findings/TRUST-04-held-crate-handed-to-anyone-who-names-its-owner.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A crate held for a head is put out for anyone who says they have come for it, by number or just by the head's name or job
   - Fix: Release a held crate only to whoever it is for, to their own staff, or to someone they have named by PDA, and ask anyone else who sent them
222. **[API-02](findings/API-02-voice-name-and-seen-name-differ.md)** (confirmed, core): The server names one person three ways, and the window matches a voice to a face by name, so a Captain whose ID shows an honorific is never obeyed
   - Fix: Find the speaker among people_in_view by details.handle, which the server already ties to the voice, and fall back to the name only when there is no handle
223. **[CARGO-09](findings/CARGO-09-note-that-someone-is-inside-never-lapses.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A note that a visitor is inside a locked room never lapses, so one who left unseen has the door tried for them for good and stops orders, rounds and janitor calls
   - Fix: Strike the note when a let-out fails because they are not in that room, give the note an age limit, and do not let a standing door want switch off order-taking
224. **[DESK-08](findings/DESK-08-told-of-a-mess-in-a-big-room-it-looks-from-the-door-and-says-it-is-cleaned.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Told of a mess in a room bigger than it can see, a janitor stands inside the door five seconds, sees none, and tells the caller it is cleaned up
   - Fix: Before a told mess task is finished with no mess seen, send go_to with middle true for that room once, and say it found no mess rather than that the mess is cleaned up
225. **[DESK-09](findings/DESK-09-mop-put-down-to-take-up-a-rag-is-forgotten-and-a-new-one-asked-for.md)** (confirmed, janitor): A janitor that put its mop and bucket down to scrub with a rag forgets where they are, and asks its head for something better than a rag
   - Fix: Remember the room it put its mop and bucket down in, and in supplyStep go back there for them before searching or asking its head
226. **[HEAD-04](findings/HEAD-04-any-staff-line-with-out-of-or-i-need-is-an-order.md)** (confirmed, head): Anything a janitor says near the Head of Personnel with "I need", "out of" or "supplies" in it is noted as asking for supplies, and a crate is ordered
   - Fix: Take an ask only from the set asking line or a line that says I need something for my work, and take a report only from the person whose turn it is, or one that begins with the head's first name and reads as a report
227. **[HEAD-10](findings/HEAD-10-no-meeting-room-found-falls-back-to-the-bar-staff-cannot-enter.md)** (confirmed, head): When the server finds no meeting room on the Head of Personnel's own deck, the window falls back to the Bar, which the server's own comment says the staff cannot get into
   - Fix: Have the server look for a meeting room on every station deck, nearest first, and in the window drop the Bar fallback so a head with no room tells the Captain once and holds no meeting
228. **[KNA-03](findings/KNA-03-janitor-in-cargo-bay-walks-at-its-locked-door.md)** (confirmed, doors): A janitor let into the Cargo Bay walks into its locked lobby door for five seconds, then asks out by the wrong door
   - Fix: End a walk at once when the route just planned runs through a shut airlock that is locked to the body, say which door, and ask to be let out by that door
229. **[KNB-01](findings/KNB-01-warehouse-walled-off-by-its-own-crates.md)** (confirmed, logs): In most rounds no technician can walk into the Warehouse - crates spawn across its floor just inside its only airlock, and no body can press the shutter button
   - Fix: Walk to a spot the body has a route to (just inside the door its ID opens) when the chosen spot has none, and give bodies a way to press a door button they can see
230. **[LOGA-06](findings/LOGA-06-quartermaster-calls-its-meeting-from-the-lobby-and-closes-it-before-the-first-report.md)** (confirmed, logs): The Quartermaster walks out of its meeting room to call a technician, begins the meeting from the lobby, walks off mid-turn and misses the first report, and tells the Captain 0 of 2 there
   - Fix: Keep the head inside its meeting room while it calls and holds the meeting: walk up only to staff in that room, and do not begin the meeting or call on anyone until it is really in the room (CHK-07); then book the call-on for whoever is named and give a begun meeting a short grace before closing it
231. **[MULTI-02](findings/MULTI-02-order-docks-while-its-orderer-is-out-and-a-workmate-sends-the-shuttle-back.md)** (confirmed, supply): An order that docks while the technician who placed it is out of the bay is unloaded as plain freight by its workmate, the shuttle is sent back and called home again for nothing, and after two misses the order is given up with its crate sitting in the bay
   - Fix: Once the order has left the shopping list and the shuttle has docked home with it, stop moving the shuttle and stop the timeout, let order_arrived find the crates in the bay whenever the orderer is next there, and let an orderer out of the bay go back to its post
232. **[MULTI-07](findings/MULTI-07-crate-sent-to-a-second-collector-is-fought-over-by-both.md)** (confirmed, hands): A crate the head sends a second collector for is gone after by both, and at the crate each pulls it out of the other's hands and wipes the other's claim on it
   - Fix: Refuse haul_collected, haul_released and haul_crate_back when someone else has the crate in hand, clear collected_by on failure only if it is still this body's, and have the window end a COLLECT task the server refuses for that
233. **[PERF-02](findings/PERF-02-each-sense-event-sends-the-whole-crew-at-once.md)** (confirmed, core): Each sense event sends the whole crew's state at once, one update per event even when many come in one tick, about 150 KB each at 11 crew and 600 KB at 40, 90 percent of it old events
   - Fix: Let on_sense_event ask for one update at the end of the tick instead of one at once, and send each body's events newer than its acked_seq only
234. **[SUP-05](findings/SUP-05-shuttle-leaves-with-a-full-crate-a-workmate-has-claimed.md)** (confirmed, supply): The shuttle is sent away, and its load sold, while a full crate a workmate has set off for is still aboard
   - Fix: Decide whether the shuttle may leave from every full crate aboard, not only from those no workmate has claimed

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 14

235. **[ARR-15](findings/ARR-15-room-with-no-door-locked-to-it-is-taken-for-one-to-be-let-into.md)** (confirmed, security): A room with no door locked to security, that it could not walk into for fire doors or a breach, is asked of the Captain and then forced open by engineering
   - Fix: Have security_state send empty keepers lists too, treat an empty list as no locked door in keepersOf so no shutOut is opened, and tell the list once what is in the way
236. **[ASYNC-01](findings/ASYNC-01-nearest-to-speaker-decided-before-the-others-have-heard.md)** (confirmed, brain): Who is nearest a line put to several is decided before the others have heard it, so two NPCs often both answer
   - Fix: Decide nearest on the server for the hearers of one line, or have the window hold a group line a second and decide once every hearer's event is in
237. **[ASYNC-02](findings/ASYNC-02-result-of-the-llms-own-step-taken-for-the-drivers.md)** (confirmed, driver): The answer to a step the LLM took is read as the answer to the driver's step, because answers are matched by tool name only
   - Fix: Send a call number with every tool call, have the server put it on the action_result, and match noteResult on it, or at the least drop lastAct, without failing it, when the LLM sends a walk or errand (never on a say)
238. **[CHEAT-05](findings/CHEAT-05-cargo-sees-inside-shut-crates.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Cargo staff know what is inside every shut crate, which is empty, which holds mail, and what aboard the shuttle bars it, without opening anything
   - Fix: Know a crate's contents only from having opened it or seen it open, keep that on the controller, and treat a shut crate never looked into as full
239. **[CHEAT-06](findings/CHEAT-06-cargo-knows-shuttle-bay-and-held-crates-from-anywhere.md)** (confirmed, cargo): Cargo staff are told whether the shuttle has docked, what is waiting in the bay and the lobby, and where each held crate is, wherever they are standing
   - Fix: Fill freight, tidy and held from what the body last saw, refreshed only while it is in the bay or lobby or can see the place, and keep the last sight with its time
240. **[ENG-02](findings/ENG-02-emitter-switched-on-but-unpowered-is-taken-for-firing.md)** (confirmed, engineering): An emitter that is switched on but has no power is taken for a firing one, so a dead engine is reported lit and sent to be relit every five minutes for ever
   - Fix: Have switch_emitter and the machine state count an emitter as firing only when it is active and powered, and give the relight a reason word back so the Chief Engineer stops sending it and tells the Captain the emitters have no power
241. **[JOBS-01](findings/JOBS-01-security-officer-cargo-and-engineering-taken-for-cargo-staff-and-engineers.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A department security officer, Security Officer (Cargo) or (Engineering), is taken for a cargo technician or a station engineer
   - Fix: Send each person's base job title from the server (crew_npc_job_of(person).title) beside the ID assignment and match jobs on that, or failing that strip a trailing bracketed department before matching
242. **[KNB-07](findings/KNB-07-door-tool-finds-people-through-walls-and-reads-their-mind.md)** (confirmed, doors): The door tool finds the person it is opening for through a shut door, by name or by job, and reads which door they want straight from their controller
   - Fix: Open the door that was named by the knock, the PDA message or the speech, and learn who is there by seeing them once it is open
243. **[SEC-09](findings/SEC-09-every-cuffs-failure-is-told-as-they-would-not-stay-still.md)** (confirmed, security): Every way the cuffs fail is told as they would not stay still, so someone who cannot be cuffed is batoned again every half minute for good
   - Fix: Have put_cuffs_on say why it failed (cannot_cuff, no_hand, moved) and send that reason back, and have the window give up on cannot_cuff and not set force for anything but moved
244. **[SUP-07](findings/SUP-07-any-pda-message-to-a-person-wipes-the-notice-owed-them.md)** (confirmed, supply): Any PDA message to a person strikes off the first crate notice owed to them, so a note about mail cancels the word that their order has come in
   - Fix: Have the window say which notice a message is about and have tool_message strike off only a notice of that kind
245. **[TRB-04](findings/TRB-04-a-wanted-person-found-dead-is-cuffed-dragged-to-a-cell-and-reported-jailed.md)** (confirmed, security): A wanted person found dead is told they are under arrest, cuffed, dragged to a cell and reported to the Captain as jailed, and the cell then counts as empty
   - Fix: Send a dead flag with each person in view, and have serveStep report a wanted person found dead as an outcome to the desk instead of arresting them, the desk then telling the Captain and striking the warrant
246. **[TRUST-03](findings/TRUST-03-speaker-rank-read-from-the-voice-name-alone.md)** (confirmed, senses): Who said something is taken from the voice alone, so a voice made to sound like the Captain is the Captain, whoever is standing there
   - Fix: Have the server send voice_matches with every line from a human (false when a player's chat would add "(as ...)"), and have the window give no rank to a line whose voice does not match, and take rank from the person behind the handle when there is one
247. **[TRUST-08](findings/TRUST-08-pda-word-goes-to-the-first-pda-with-that-name.md)** (confirmed, senses): A PDA message the crew send by name goes to the first PDA with that name, so a second PDA renamed to a head's name takes all the head's word
   - Fix: Have messenger_named collect every visible PDA with that name and, when there is more than one, pick the one whose job the window names (it has it from pda_people), else the one aboard, else refuse as ambiguous
248. **[TRUST-01](findings/TRUST-01-janitor-leads-anyone-into-rooms-locked-to-them.md)** (confirmed, brain): A janitor asked the way leads anyone, by its own ID, into the Custodial Closet or the maintenance tunnels
   - Fix: Have the server work out once per map which rooms the crew at large cannot walk into (maintenance included) and send them with places; leave those out of the lead offer unless the asker is command, a superior or of the NPC's own job

## Bugs: low (109)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 103

249. **[CHEAT-13](findings/CHEAT-13-technician-knows-the-cargo-budget-from-anywhere.md)** (confirmed, cargo): A cargo technician with no budget program to hand still refuses an order for want of money, reading a budget it cannot see
   - Fix: In tool_order read the budget through cargo_budget(), which needs the budget program on a carried PDA, and with no program check the money at the console in place_order
250. **[PERF-03](findings/PERF-03-every-body-looks-in-the-same-tick.md)** (confirmed, senses): Every body of a crew spawned together looks round in the same tick each second, so the whole crew's sight work and every sighting it raises land in one tick
   - Fix: Start each body's looping look timer after a random first wait of up to one second, so the crew's looks are spread across the twenty ticks of each second
251. **[SIM-02](findings/SIM-02-crash-in-reply-handling-passes-as-a-dead-model.md)** (confirmed, tools): A crash in the window code after the model answers is caught as a dead model, and the simulator still says all passed
   - Fix: Have the stand-in's fetch keep every error it throws itself, have act() keep every brain_log decision whose error is not one of those (and not the two known no-answer outcomes of a CHOICE or READING record), count unhandled rejections too, print them all and fail the run if there are any
252. **[SUP-08](findings/SUP-08-pda-message-text-is-sent-as-raw-html.md)** (confirmed, supply): A crew NPC's PDA message skips the game's cleaning, so its text reaches the other person's chat as raw HTML
   - Fix: Run the text through the messenger's own sanitize_pda_message before it is sent or kept for resending
253. **[ARR-18](findings/ARR-18-each-new-go-at-it-by-the-same-attacker-is-told-to-the-captain-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Every fresh go at security by the same person with no warrant, once it has been stopped, is told to the Head of Security and the Captain again
   - Fix: Keep when each attacker was last reported in beat, by name, and report the same person again only after some minutes or once a warrant on them has come and gone
254. **[ASYNC-04](findings/ASYNC-04-talk-waits-behind-a-choice-and-behind-the-first-in-line.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A reply that is sitting out its short cooldown lets a job choice take the model first, and holds up every other NPC's reply behind it
   - Fix: In startTalk take the first queued NPC that is ready, not only the head of the queue, and do not start a choice while a talk is due within a few seconds
255. **[BRAIN-08](findings/BRAIN-08-reasons-cut-off-mid-word-by-the-schema-and-fed-back.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): One reason in four for a feeling and one in eight for a job choice is cut off mid-word by the reply schema, and the stump is fed back into later prompts
   - Fix: Ask for a reason in a few words in the prompt, raise the schema maxLength well above the kept length, and cut the kept text back to its last whole word or clause
256. **[BRAIN-10](findings/BRAIN-10-wrong-or-missing-model-shown-as-ready.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): With qwen3.5 9b not installed the window takes whichever model Ollama lists first, embedding models too, and with none at all it still says Ollama ready
   - Fix: Choose only a chat model, prefer one whose name starts with the preferred family, and show a warning instead of Ollama ready when the preferred model is missing or nothing usable is installed
257. **[CARGO-16](findings/CARGO-16-whoever-is-knocking-is-booked-as-a-person-inside-the-bay.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Let out of an inner room after an unnamed knock, the stand-in name whoever is knocking is booked as a person inside the outer room, and stays there for the round
   - Fix: In afterActing never book SOMEONE_INSIDE in the department's list, and better book whoever the server says it opened for
258. **[CHK-01](findings/CHK-01-voice-test-crashes-fixture-brain-out-of-step.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): voice.ts crashes part way through because the test brain in fixtures.ts lacks fields the window code now reads
   - Fix: Make the blank brain in one exported function in the window code and have both ingest and fixtures.ts call it
259. **[CHK-04](findings/CHK-04-job-module-loaded-first-crashes-at-import.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Loading any job's file before the rest of the window code throws at import, because jobs/index.ts builds its list while the jobs are still loading
   - Fix: Build the JOBS list the first time jobFor is called, not when jobs/index.ts is loaded
260. **[CHK-06](findings/CHK-06-two-dead-names-in-janitor-the-type-check-would-flag.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Two names in jobs/janitor.ts are never read - a wait constant left from the first build and the via argument of letInStep
   - Fix: Delete WAIT_AT_COUNTER_DS, and drop the via parameter of letInStep (or use it), so the only wait at a locked door is LET_IN_WAIT_DS
261. **[CHK-08](findings/CHK-08-sim-end-checks-fail-on-work-still-under-way-at-the-cut-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Two simulator scenarios fail by chance because their end checks read the crew at a fixed second, with a look round or a reminder still under way
   - Fix: Stop starting new held checks and look rounds in the last minute of a scenario and run the clock on until no body has a walk or a message in hand, before the end checks
262. **[CORE-05](findings/CORE-05-every-ack-rebuilds-and-resends-the-whole-crew.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Every ack the window sends makes the server rebuild and resend every body's whole state, though nothing the window shows has changed
   - Fix: Return FALSE from ui_act for ack, as brain_log already does, since the window already knows the number it has just sent
263. **[CORE-08](findings/CORE-08-walk-back-to-post-cancels-work-begun-in-the-tenth-of-a-second-before.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): The walk back to the post starts a tenth of a second after it is decided without looking again, and silently cancels any walk, errand or search the brain began in between
   - Fix: Start the return walk through a small proc that first checks no walk, errand or search has begun and the body is still off its spot, and does nothing if one has
264. **[DESK-04](findings/DESK-04-putting-back-marks-are-shared-by-every-janitor-by-task-number.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): The note that a janitor is putting its mop and bucket back is kept by task number for every janitor at once, so one janitor's note steers another
   - Fix: Keep the putting-back note on the task itself, as task.puttingBack, instead of in a module-wide Set of task ids
265. **[DESK-12](findings/DESK-12-no-soap-or-rag-reply-is-not-read-by-cargo-as-needing-scrubbing.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A janitor's I have no soap or rag reply is not read by cargo as the mess wanting scrubbing, so the next janitor is asked plainly to come and try
   - Fix: Word the janitor's reply with NEEDS_SCRUBBING (it needs scrubbing with soap or a rag), or widen cargo's test to soap or (a )?rag
266. **[DOOR-10](findings/DOOR-10-plastic-flaps-rule-turns-back-crawlers-and-riders.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Our plastic flaps rule refuses a route to a mob lying down, riding a mulebot or phasing, all of which the flaps let through
   - Fix: Let the route through when the one asking is lying down or buckled to a mulebot, read from the pass info, and say in the comment what the rule cannot know
267. **[DOOR-13](findings/DOOR-13-go-to-door-of-a-visited-place-off-the-station-is-a-runtime.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Going to the door of a place the body has stood in that is not a station room, a shuttle say, is a runtime and the brain gets no answer
   - Fix: In tool_go_to_door answer FALSE when the named place has no station area, and give crew_npc_doors_of a null guard
268. **[DOOR-17](findings/DOOR-17-door-with-its-id-scanner-off-taken-as-opening-to-the-id.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door whose ID scanner is cut or switched off opens to nobody, and the door code takes it as opening to everyone whose ID has the access
   - Fix: Add one helper for whether a door will open to a body by hand, requiresID and allowed and power and no bolts or weld, and use it wherever the door code now asks allowed alone
269. **[DOOR-18](findings/DOOR-18-armour-plate-seal-and-no-panel-tried-twice-and-reported-as-would-not-open.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): A door with armour plating, a seal or no panel is gone at twice, and security and the Captain are told only that it would not open
   - Fix: Give the lasting causes their own reasons (plated, sealed, no_panel), add them to the final list in forcing.ts and give whyNot words for each
270. **[DRV-02](findings/DRV-02-step-clear-count-never-starts-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Having stepped clear twice in a room, a body never steps clear in that room again, on any later visit
   - Fix: Start the count again when the body leaves the room, and clear the map in stopSession
271. **[DRV-04](findings/DRV-04-talk-hold-start-goes-stale.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The start of a talk hold is kept from an earlier conversation, so a body spoken to later walks off at once
   - Fix: Clear heldSince whenever drive returns without reaching the hold, or count the hold from lastSpokenToAt
272. **[DRV-08](findings/DRV-08-after-stepping-aside-nothing-at-all-for-fifteen-seconds.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Having stepped aside, the body takes no step of any kind for 15 seconds, so a second ask to move, an order, being told to leave and a door held for it all wait
   - Fix: Keep the body off its own routine work for ASIDE_HOLD_MS with a hold of its own, not by putting driveAfter forward, so that anything ahead of routine work still goes at once
273. **[DRV-09](findings/DRV-09-shut-in-try-at-leaving-spent-on-a-step-held-for-talk.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): Shut in, its next try at leaving is spent on a walk the talk hold then stops, so it waits another 20 seconds, or two minutes if it was let in, before it really tries
   - Fix: Set tryLeavingAt only once the walk is really issued, after the pause after saying and the talk hold, not where the gate is checked
274. **[DRV-10](findings/DRV-10-llm-status-line-is-set-once-and-never-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, driver): The window's Ollama line is worked out once when it opens and never again, so it shows ready while every call fails, or unreachable while calls work
   - Fix: Keep the outcome of the last few real LLM calls in brain.ts and show that in the status line, and pick a fallback model that can chat
275. **[ENG-07](findings/ENG-07-light-order-sent-by-pda-is-never-answered-and-is-sent-again-every-minute.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer given the engine by PDA never answers that it has it, so the Chief Engineer sends the order again every minute until the engine is lit
   - Fix: Have the engineer answer a light order that came by PDA with "The engine, right away." by PDA, and let the Chief Engineer give the order at most twice before it waits on the lit or stuck word instead
276. **[ENG-12](findings/ENG-12-captain-told-i-do-not-know-this-engine-by-the-chief-engineer.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): On any map but MetaStation the Captain is told by the Chief Engineer "The engine is not lit - I do not know this engine", the engineer's "I" passed on as the chief's own
   - Fix: Word the unknown-engine reason without I, for example "the engine room is not one engineering has the steps for", as whyNot does for doors
277. **[HAND-09](findings/HAND-09-explore-walk-broken-off-for-any-reason-writes-the-room-off-for-the-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): An explore walk that ends for any reason, a stun or a queue at a door included, writes the room off as unreachable for the rest of the round
   - Fix: Write a room into unreachable_places from walk_finished only when the reason is CREW_NPC_NO_WAY, and give the other failures a time after which the room may be tried again
278. **[HAND-11](findings/HAND-11-unasked-thing-kept-for-good-after-a-minute-busy-or-a-second-gift.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A thing pushed into its hand is kept for good if the body stays busy for a minute, or if a second thing is pushed into the other hand before the first is put down
   - Fix: Keep a list of unasked things, not one, and when busy keep waiting as long as the thing is still held instead of giving up after ten tries
279. **[HAND-13](findings/HAND-13-fetch-from-a-locker-takes-an-empty-spray-bottle.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A fetch from a locker takes the first thing of that name, an empty spray bottle included, though every other pick up passes empty ones over
   - Fix: Skip is_spent things in take_from_container as tool_pick_up does, and count them in what the locker holds
280. **[HAND-14](findings/HAND-14-crate-behind-a-shut-door-is-known-to-be-there.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A crate on the far side of a shut airlock counts as seen, so the body knows a crate it cannot see is jammed there and sets off to move it
   - Fix: In crate_in_the_way count a crate as seen only if it is in view itself, and when only the door is in view walk to the door first and look again
281. **[HEAD-08](findings/HEAD-08-one-crate-unpacked-tells-everyone-waiting-on-any-order.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Word that one crate is unpacked tells everyone the head has ordered for that their things have come, including those whose order has not arrived
   - Fix: Record on each ask the order and crate numbers it is waiting on, and on word that crate N is unpacked tell only the asks whose crate that was
282. **[HEAD-09](findings/HEAD-09-pickup-turn-indexes-a-list-that-is-reordered-each-time.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): Who is sent for a crate is picked by a round-wide counter into a list that is put in a new order every time, so after the first crate the one who asked is seldom the one sent
   - Fix: Send the askers of an order first in order of asking, counting from zero for each order, and keep the round-wide turn only for the crates beyond the askers
283. **[JAN-07](findings/JAN-07-custodial-locator-read-with-the-network-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): The custodial locator is read with the station network down, though the program needs it, and the closet is named when the locator shows no gear there
   - Fix: In has_custodial_locator check computer.get_ntnet_status() as engine_reading does, and say plainly when the locator shows nothing rather than naming a room it did not show
284. **[JAN-14](findings/JAN-14-dry-sink-still-taken-as-water-and-a-missed-click-reported-as-run-dry.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): A sink that has run dry is still taken as water to hand, and a wetting whose click never landed is reported as the sink having run dry
   - Fix: Take a sink as water only with 5 units or more in it, as a mop bucket is taken only with water in it, and in wet_mop tell a click that could not be made from a sink with no water
285. **[JOBS-07](findings/JOBS-07-mail-never-handed-to-someone-whose-id-shows-an-honorific.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Mail is never handed to someone whose ID shows an honorific, such as Captain John, because the mail is listed under the real name and the person in view goes by the shown name
   - Fix: Have freight_state send, for each name in mail_for, the handle of that person when they are in view (matched by mind on the server), and match DELIVER on that handle instead of on the name
286. **[KNA-12](findings/KNA-12-voice-not-told-how-a-forcing-job-ended.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Once a door-forcing job is closed the voice is told nothing of how it ended, and says the door is forced when it is not
   - Fix: Keep the outcome of the last forcing job for a few minutes and give it to the voice as a cue
287. **[KNA-14](findings/KNA-14-warrant-over-fifteen-minutes-cut-without-saying.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A warrant declared for more than 15 minutes is cut to 15 and the answer does not say so
   - Fix: Keep the minutes that were asked for beside the minutes given, and add the sentence about the cell timer to the first answer as the later one already has it
288. **[KNA-17](findings/KNA-17-mess-calls-one-message-a-room-and-to-janitors-who-are-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician sends a janitor one PDA message for every room with a mess, seconds apart, and sends them to a janitor it can see lying on the floor
   - Fix: Put every room that is due a call into one message to the same janitor, and pass over a janitor who is seen to be down
289. **[KNA-20](findings/KNA-20-kitchen-door-counted-as-a-door-of-the-bar.md)** (not checked, finder sure, doors): Any airlock beside any square of a room is taken for a door of it, so the Kitchen's door is a third door of the Bar, with both its sides on fridges
   - Fix: In crew_npc_doors_of keep a door only when its inside and outside tiles are on its line of passage and neither holds a dense machine or table
290. **[KNA-22](findings/KNA-22-anyone-seen-inside-cargo-is-told-to-the-voice-as-let-in-by-staff.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Anyone a technician sees inside a cargo room is described to its voice as let in by someone who works here, though nobody let them in
   - Fix: Say let in only of those on record as let in, and give those merely seen inside a cue that says nobody here is known to have let them in
291. **[KNA-24](findings/KNA-24-crate-left-off-the-squares-is-never-put-on-one-once-a-square-frees.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A crate cargo once left off the marked squares is never put on one, even after a square comes free, and the log never says where a hauled crate ended
   - Fix: Clear crew_npc_left_on when a square comes free that was not free when the crate was left, and name the tile in the log line for every haul
292. **[KNA-33](findings/KNA-33-engineer-forces-and-leaves-open-a-door-into-a-room-with-no-air.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer forces open, and leaves standing open, a door into a room that has lost its air, because only its own side of the door is looked at
   - Fix: Before taking a door's power, look for a pressure warning on the door's fire door or a hull breach in view, and if there is one stop and say the room has no air instead of forcing it
293. **[KNA-34](findings/KNA-34-told-to-get-someone-else-to-move-aside-the-hauler-steps-aside-itself.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Anyone whose name is anywhere in a line asking someone to move aside steps aside, so the hauler the way was being cleared for walked off as well
   - Fix: In asideOverhears take a line as asking this NPC only when it is said to it, or its name is the one called on at the head of the line, not when the name turns up later in it
294. **[KNA-35](findings/KNA-35-pda-message-with-the-word-now-in-it-is-given-up-after-ninety-seconds.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Any PDA message that will not send and happens to have the word now in it is given up after ninety seconds, reports to the Captain included, and the window has already let it go
   - Fix: Have the window mark a message as short-lived when it sends it (meeting calls only) and keep every other unsent message the full eight minutes, whatever words are in it
295. **[KNB-02](findings/KNB-02-no-route-log-asks-the-same-pathfinder-twice.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The no-route log line says the game's other pathfinder finds none either, but it asks the same pathfinder a second time
   - Fix: Drop the second opinion from log_no_route and print what the route search actually met instead, a flood fill from the body that names the furthest tile reached and what stands on the next ones
296. **[KNB-18](findings/KNB-18-simulator-budget-free-without-a-quartermaster-and-twice-the-real-start.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The simulator charges nothing for an order when no Quartermaster is aboard, and starts cargo's budget at 2,000 credits where a real round starts with 500 to 1,000
   - Fix: Charge every order to the simulated budget as the server does, whoever is aboard, and start it at what a real round starts with, raised only in the scenarios that need more
297. **[LIFE-04](findings/LIFE-04-after-the-look-a-container-is-worked-from-wherever-the-body-is.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): After the look into a locker or crate the body takes things out and shuts it from wherever it now is, awake or not
   - Fix: After the sleep in take_from_container, look_inside and take_mail, go on only if the errand is the same one and the body can still reach the container and act, else leave it as it is
298. **[LIFE-06](findings/LIFE-06-window-is-sent-a-half-built-list-of-who-is-in-view.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The window is sent, and acts on, a list of who is in view that is only half rebuilt, each time someone new comes into sight
   - Fix: In look_around build people_in_view in a local list, assign it once the loop is done, and emit the comes-into-view events after that
299. **[LIFE-07](findings/LIFE-07-crate-pushed-on-by-a-body-that-is-down.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A body knocked down or killed while pushing a crate clear goes on stepping and pushing it
   - Fix: Before each body.Move in push_clear, stop unless the body can move as the walk loop would let it, and say why it stopped
300. **[LOGB-07](findings/LOGB-07-could-not-get-the-crate-out-is-told-after-it-got-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician tells the Quartermaster it could not get a crate out to the lobby after it has got it out, and the Quartermaster sends another technician to see to it
   - Fix: Clear brain.gaveUp when a later haul of the same crate succeeds, and have the Quartermaster check the held crates before it sends anyone to see to one
301. **[MEM-03](findings/MEM-03-news-about-a-person-is-thrown-away-as-a-sighting.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): News about a person is thrown away as a sighting if it says meet, or is and any room name inside any word
   - Fix: In isSighting match room names as whole words, drop meeting from the met words, and call a note a sighting only if it has nothing else in it beyond the name, a verb of being or seeing and the room
302. **[MEM-09](findings/MEM-09-second-person-to-ask-for-the-same-work-is-never-told-it-is-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): The second person to ask for the same work is never told it is done, and an order merged into an old task reports to the first asker
   - Fix: Keep a list of everyone waiting on a task, not one askedBy, and owe each of them word when it is done, the latest superior first
303. **[MEM-10](findings/MEM-10-someone-seen-through-a-window-is-remembered-as-in-the-npcs-own-room.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Someone seen through a window or an open door is remembered as being in the NPC's own room
   - Fix: In observe record person.place, the room the server says they stand in, and fall back to npc.location only when it is missing
304. **[MEM-12](findings/MEM-12-my-bodys-hands-are-full-is-said-as-is-hands-are-full.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): My body's hands are full is said aloud as I's hands are full, and was becomes am
   - Fix: Add rules for my body's and your body's before the bare ones, keep the tense of was, and only strip a third-person s from verbs that are not es-forms
305. **[MEM-14](findings/MEM-14-rooms-only-heard-of-are-described-as-visited-and-seen-empty.md)** (not checked, finder sure, memory): Rooms the NPC has only been told of are described to the model as rooms it visited and saw nothing in
   - Fix: Keep lastVisit unset for rooms learned without going there, and describe them as known of, not seen, until the body has stood in them
306. **[MULTI-05](findings/MULTI-05-second-order-from-one-asker-within-two-minutes-is-dropped-by-the-free-technician.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A second order from the same person within two minutes is refused by the free technician because the busy one took the first, and nobody places it though the voice says it will
   - Fix: Key an order claim by the asker and what was asked for, or let a claim go as soon as the claimer has placed its order, so a second asking can be taken by a technician who is free
307. **[MULTI-09](findings/MULTI-09-knock-from-inside-left-to-the-quartermaster-by-name-order-and-nobody-goes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A knock from inside a cargo room is left to whoever in cargo has the first name in the alphabet, the Quartermaster included, so with the Quartermaster in sight neither technician goes
   - Fix: In the name-order tie-break count only technicians who are on their feet and not busy (isTechnician, not down, not cuffed, not hauling), not the Quartermaster
308. **[PARSE-11](findings/PARSE-11-words-in-double-quotes-are-cut-out-of-what-was-heard.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Words a speaker puts in double quotes are cut out of what the crew hear, so there is blood all over the bar with blood quoted names no mess
   - Fix: Take the words from the event's details.message, or from the first quote after says to the last quote before (person, never by pairing quote marks
309. **[PARSE-12](findings/PARSE-12-a-whispered-line-is-heard-but-never-read-as-said.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A line whispered to a crew member wakes it but is never read as said, so whatever it agrees to is refused as nothing said called for it
   - Fix: Treat says and whispers alike in every report filter, through one helper isSpeechLine, or have describeEvent write every heard line with says
310. **[PARSE-18](findings/PARSE-18-ok-go-check-the-bar-may-go-unanswered.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): An order that begins with ok, thanks or alright, ok go check the bar, is taken as a goodbye that needs no answer, so the order is carried out without a word back
   - Fix: In buildTalk never allow silence when an order was made out or work was told, and in needsNoAnswer require the line to be nothing but the closing words, give or take a name and please
311. **[PERF-01](findings/PERF-01-href-log-is-99-percent-crew-traffic.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): href.log and href.log.json are 99 percent crew traffic, every brain log record written there in full a second time, past the trim and the rate limit
   - Fix: Send acks for all crew as one act per update, stop sending a ROUTINE brain log record that repeats the last one for that body, and ask the owner whether tgui may skip logging the payload of a crew brain link act
312. **[PERF-07](findings/PERF-07-ui-data-does-work-in-the-world-lost-crates-written-off-there.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): Building the window's data does work in the world - a lost crate is written off, said aloud and owed a PDA message from inside ui_data, and shuttle crates and held crates are marked there
   - Fix: Move write_off_lost_crates and the held-crate and shuttle-crate marking into the cargo body's once-a-second look, and leave held_state and freight_state reading only
313. **[QM-06](findings/QM-06-word-of-an-order-not-in-its-book-is-answered-and-dropped.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): Word that an order has come in is answered I have that even when the order is not in the Quartermaster's book, so the crate numbers reach nobody
   - Fix: Say I have that to has-come-in word only when noteDocked found the order, so the technician falls back to sending the numbers to whoever ordered, and read the book before taking new orders after the window is reopened
314. **[QM-09](findings/QM-09-captain-who-refuses-paper-is-asked-again-every-five-minutes.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): A Captain who says no to the Quartermaster's own crate of paper is asked about a new one every five minutes for the rest of the round
   - Fix: In orderForItself, do not order again a crate the Captain has refused, or not for a long while, and say so in the cues
315. **[QM-11](findings/QM-11-order-that-will-not-go-through-is-given-again-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): An order a technician says did not go through is given out again every two minutes with no limit, and whoever ordered is never told
   - Fix: Count the failures on the order, tell whoever ordered after the second, and after the third hold it and tell the Captain, instead of giving it out again
316. **[SEC-11](findings/SEC-11-pardon-with-cuffs-left-on-is-reported-freed-and-never-retried.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A pardon whose cuffs would not come off is reported to the Captain as freed and never tried again, leaving the person in security's cuffs
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing for free, treat ok with cuffs_left as not done, keep the toFree entry for another try, and say so in the outcome after the last try
317. **[SEC-12](findings/SEC-12-prisoner-who-steps-out-of-the-cell-in-sight-is-reported-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A prisoner who steps out of the cell behind the officer, in plain sight and in its cuffs, is reported to the Head of Security as lost
   - Fix: In beatAfterActing for jail, push the lost outcome only when got_away comes without a handle, and set lastSeen from details.place
318. **[SEC-16](findings/SEC-16-free-name-from-the-window-goes-into-the-log-uncapped.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The name sent with free is written into game.log and back to the brain as it came, with no length cap and no line breaks taken out
   - Fix: In tool_free, cut person_name down the way tool_order cuts for_name (the not_a_name regex and MAX_NAME_LEN) before it is matched, stored or logged
319. **[SECT-14](findings/SECT-14-a-stranger-whose-name-is-inside-anothers-is-counted-as-asked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A second stranger whose first name is inside the words said to the first, Ian beside Brian, is counted as asked and is put out without a question
   - Fix: In guardAfterSaying match the first name as a whole word, and better still note which stranger the step was for instead of searching the line
320. **[SECT-18](findings/SECT-18-warden-and-detective-are-not-counted-as-security.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A Warden or Detective is not counted as security, so a warrant on one is taken and one who brings a warrant is told to take it to their head
   - Fix: Make isSecurity true for every job of the Security department in hierarchy.ts, Warden and Detective included, and keep isOfficer for who makes arrests
321. **[SECT-19](findings/SECT-19-nobody-or-lost-anywhere-in-an-answer-is-owning-up.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An answer with nobody, no one or lost anywhere in it, such as Nobody was at the counter so Donna let me in, is taken as owning up to having no business there
   - Fix: Look for a workmate's name first and let it win, and take nobody or no one only at the start of the answer or as nobody sent me
322. **[SECT-23](findings/SECT-23-try-again-anywhere-in-the-captains-line-sends-a-hurt-officer-back-out.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Try again anywhere in what the Captain sends security, Don't try again until you are healed included, sends a hurt officer back to making arrests
   - Fix: Take try again only as the whole order or at its start, with no negation before it, and only while some security member is out hurt
323. **[SECT-24](findings/SECT-24-five-of-them-for-resisting-said-when-the-cap-ate-them.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A prisoner who fought back on a warrant of eleven minutes or more is reported as having five of their minutes for resisting, when the cap took some or all of them
   - Fix: Carry the minutes actually added for resisting in the outcome and say that number, or leave the clause out when it is nought
324. **[SECT-25](findings/SECT-25-told-to-say-warrant-for-the-clown-which-it-cannot-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Told the clown is in the bar, security answers To declare one, say Warrant for The clown, and then cannot read those very words
   - Fix: Do not offer words the reader refuses, test sightedName's result against NOT_A_NAME, and for a description ask for the name instead
325. **[SECT-26](findings/SECT-26-staff-keep-sending-sightings-of-someone-jailed-or-pardoned-until-the-next-meeting.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Staff go on sending security sightings of someone already jailed or pardoned for up to ten minutes, and security drops them without a word
   - Fix: Have whoever keeps the list answer a sighting of someone no longer wanted with a fixed line that staff read to strike the name from their own list
326. **[SENSE-02](findings/SENSE-02-harm-sense-names-a-janitor-with-a-mop-and-misses-a-gunman.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The harm sense, once switched on, names a janitor with a mop as the one standing over a victim, misses a gunman, and misses a beating spread over seconds
   - Fix: Judge a weapon by what it is (sharp, a gun, a baton, combat mode) not by force alone, look further than one tile for a gun, and compare health against the look of a few seconds ago, not one second ago
327. **[SENSE-04](findings/SENSE-04-blind-or-shut-in-a-locker-keeps-seeing-an-open-door-and-water.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A body that is blinded or shut in a locker forgets what it saw but keeps an open door and water to hand in view, and its people stay just seen for fifteen seconds
   - Fix: Put the clearing of sight in one helper that also resets open_door_in_view, sink_in_view, water_from and bucket_to_fill, and call it from both early returns in look_around
328. **[SIM-03](findings/SIM-03-every-voice-is-one-tile-away-and-facing-is-never-sent.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): In the simulator every crew voice is one tile away and nobody is ever turned away, so who a line was said to is never tested end to end
   - Fix: Give each body a spot in its room, send the real distance between two bodies and a facing flag with every speech_heard, as the server does
329. **[SIM-06](findings/SIM-06-janitor-checks-pass-in-scenarios-with-no-janitors.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Two janitor checks run in every scenario and pass where there are no janitors, and a tool the stand-in does not know is never a failure
   - Fix: Run the two janitor checks only when there are janitors, and count every tool call that reaches the default case as a failed check
330. **[SIM-09](findings/SIM-09-voice-test-sends-prompts-the-game-never-sends.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The model test voice.ts judges prompts the game never sends - no "speaking to you" on any line heard, everyone in view counted as having spoken, and word-for-word lines never marked
   - Fix: Build each voice case's report line with describeEvent from a real speech_heard event, pass only the speaker's handle as speakers, and pass exact from the driver's step
331. **[SIM-10](findings/SIM-10-set-off-too-soon-check-misses-walking-up-and-most-walks.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The check that nobody sets off right after speaking does not count walking up to someone, working a machine, an arrest or five other walks
   - Fix: Build the stand-in's LEAVES from the driver's own rule - every tool but say, hold and those in STAYS - by exporting STAYS from driver.ts
332. **[SIM-11](findings/SIM-11-stand-in-picks-up-from-a-closet-anywhere-without-walking.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in's pick_up takes an item out of any closet the body has ever looked in, from wherever it stands, in two seconds and without moving
   - Fix: Make the stand-in's pick_up from a remembered box walk the body to that box's room first, through the same door and fire-door checks as go_to, and leave the body there
333. **[SUP-14](findings/SUP-14-console-left-on-buy-privately-charges-the-technician.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A supply console left on "buy privately" puts a technician's order on its own bank account, though the money was checked in cargo's budget
   - Fix: In place_order look at console.self_paid, as a player sees it on the screen, and switch it off through the console's own toggleprivate action before adding the order
334. **[SUP-16](findings/SUP-16-pda-refused-for-cuffs-or-the-one-second-wait-is-called-not-working.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): A PDA message refused because the body is cuffed or down, or because one went less than a second ago, is reported as the PDA not working and is sent again later on its own
   - Fix: Before send_message_signal, test body.can_perform_action(computer, ALLOW_RESTING) and the messenger's own cooldown, and answer each with its own reason without keeping the message to resend
335. **[SUP-18](findings/SUP-18-order-cancelled-at-the-console-is-taken-for-one-aboard.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): An order someone cancels at the supply console is taken for one loaded aboard, and the technician is told the shuttle has docked without it
   - Fix: Keep the pending order's id as well as its weak reference, and when the order is gone with no shuttle trip since it was placed, end the run as cancelled and say so
336. **[TRA-07](findings/TRA-07-technician-with-no-pda-never-tells-the-quartermaster-face-to-face.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A technician with no PDA never tells the Quartermaster face to face that an order has come in, is still waiting or is lost, though that word does not go by PDA
   - Fix: Gate the arrived, waiting and lost tasks on having a PDA only when the word would go by PDA, so that word owed to the Quartermaster face to face is owed with or without one
337. **[TRB-10](findings/TRB-10-an-outcome-said-again-for-want-of-i-have-that-is-taken-again-by-the-desk.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): An officer's word on a warrant that it says again, because it did not hear I have that, is taken again by the Head of Security, and the Captain and the declarer are told twice
   - Fix: In deskOutcome keep the last few outcome lines heard from each officer with the time, and on the same line again only answer I have that, doing nothing else
338. **[CARGO-19](findings/CARGO-19-order-for-a-captain-with-an-honorific-is-pdad-to-a-name-no-pda-has.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): An order taken at the counter for someone whose ID shows an honorific is held for and messaged to the shown name, which no PDA has, so the crate number never reaches them
   - Fix: In tool_order take order_for from the asker's ID name without the honorific (get_id_name with honorifics FALSE), the name their PDA goes by, falling back to the seen name
339. **[DOOR-08](findings/DOOR-08-named-door-takes-first-of-two-with-one-name.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): Of two doors of a room that go by one name, the first found is opened, not the one the person is standing at
   - Fix: Among the doors that match the name given, take the one the person stands at, or failing that the nearest to them
340. **[DOOR-16](findings/DOOR-16-any-shut-fire-door-in-sight-is-blamed-for-a-failed-walk.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): Any shut fire door in sight is blamed for a walk that found no way, even one nowhere on the way, and that walk is then not counted towards being shut in
   - Fix: In fire_door_report blame only a shut fire door the body can walk up to and that lies nearer the goal than the body does, and pass the walk's goal in so it can tell
341. **[JAN-06](findings/JAN-06-locked-engine-air-alarm-never-unlocks-for-the-body.md)** (not checked, finder likely, engineering): A locked engine air alarm never unlocks for an engineer, because the game checks the ID of usr and the body's click carries none
   - Fix: Make the click in click_as_body as the body with world.push_usr, as work_wires and work_timer already do
342. **[JAN-10](findings/JAN-10-stubborn-mess-list-kept-by-bare-ref-and-never-pruned.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cleaning): Messes given up on are kept by their bare ref for the whole round, so a new mess that is given a dead one's ref is passed over unseen
   - Fix: Keep stubborn_messes as REF to WEAKREF and treat an entry as live only while the weakref resolves to the same mess, and drop dead entries in remember_messes
343. **[JOBS-03](findings/JOBS-03-second-crate-collected-before-the-first-empty-goes-back-loses-the-first.md)** (not checked, finder likely, cargo): Sent for two crates, a body that hauls the second before taking the first empty back leaves the first empty crate where it was unpacked for good
   - Fix: In planPickups, while another collect task of this body is unpacked and an empty is still to go back, a crate not yet hauled waits, so take_back runs first
344. **[MEM-13](findings/MEM-13-shut-in-with-no-head-aboard-it-never-writes-to-the-captain.md)** (not checked, finder likely, memory): Shut in a room with no head of its department aboard, a crew member never sends word to the Captain
   - Fix: In nextToWrite look the head up with headName from jobs/meetings.ts, which falls back to the Captain, instead of headOf and a search of the PDA list
345. **[PARSE-13](findings/PARSE-13-a-head-npc-small-talk-to-security-declares-warrants.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A crew head's small talk with the Head of Security, written by the model, is read as declaring a warrant, keep up the good work and arrest those troublemakers is a warrant on those troublemakers
   - Fix: Have crew heads declare warrants only in the fixed warrantLine words, and have the desk take a spoken line from a head as a warrant only when it begins with the verb or the warrant words, not from words in the middle of a remark
346. **[PERF-09](findings/PERF-09-window-draws-every-card-twice-for-every-update.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The Crew Brain window draws every crew card twice for every update from the server, once before the brains have taken it in and once after, and nothing skips a card that has not changed
   - Fix: Wrap NpcCard in React memo with a compare on the few fields it shows, and run ingest before render or skip the first draw of each update
347. **[QM-13](findings/QM-13-look-report-names-people-and-mess-outside-the-room.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): Sent to look at a room and report, a crew member names as in there everyone and every mess it can see, through windows and doorways into other rooms
   - Fix: In whatIsThere count only people whose place is the room looked at, and say nothing of messes unless the server says which room each is in
348. **[RT-06](findings/RT-06-two-large-brain-log-records-in-one-millisecond-still-collide.md)** (not checked, finder likely, logs): Two large brain log records sent in the same millisecond still collide, and the second is lost with a duplicate ID runtime
   - Fix: Send every brain_log record through one queue in brain.ts that lets out at most one record every few tens of milliseconds, instead of a fixed 300 ms delay per record
349. **[SEC-10](findings/SEC-10-paw-signal-edit-reaches-listeners-beyond-the-officer.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): The attack_paw edit is heard once, as meant, but it also wakes base-game listeners that never heard a monkey before, and a tackle is told as a shove
   - Fix: Keep the edit, but send it only after the combat-mode and pacifism checks a bite or tackle passes, and tell a monkey's right-click as a tackle, not a shove; the owner to say whether monkeys fighting monkeys back is wanted
350. **[SEC-13](findings/SEC-13-kit-locker-shut-on-whoever-stands-in-it.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): After taking its kit the officer shuts the security locker on anyone standing in it, and leaves it unlocked
   - Fix: Before the closing click in kit_from_locker, leave the locker open if any mob stands on its tile, and lock it again after closing with the click a player uses
351. **[SUP-10](findings/SUP-10-tidying-shuts-the-quartermasters-opened-crate.md)** (not checked, finder likely, quartermaster): The crate the Quartermaster opens for itself is shut again by a tidying technician, with the paper bin back inside where the Quartermaster cannot find it
   - Fix: Have the Quartermaster take what it ordered the crate for out of it before it leaves, and let nearest_paper_bin count a bin in a crate the body may open

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 6
