352. **[SIM-01](findings/SIM-01-stand-in-pda-always-sends-to-anyone.md)** (confirmed, tools): The simulator's PDA always sends, to any name at all, so no scenario can reach a message that fails
   - Fix: List every player in the stand-in's pda_people, make the stand-in message case look the name up in that same list and fail with the server's words when it is not there, and add a PDA-down switch that answers with the would-not-send words and keeps the message to resend
353. **[SIM-08](findings/SIM-08-stand-in-mop-never-dries-and-is-wetted-anywhere.md)** (confirmed, tools): In the simulator a mop never dries, spray never runs out, a dry mop is wetted with no water in sight, and the bucket fields are never sent
   - Fix: Give the stand-in's mop and spray a store of water and cleaner that each clean uses up (15 and about 50 messes when full), stop a dry mop being wetted from nothing when a rag is held, add a bucket, send water_from, bucket_to_fill, wants_bucket, beyond_kinds and at_door_label, and add a scenario that starts the janitor short
354. **[TRA-05](findings/TRA-05-word-of-an-old-crate-wipes-the-heads-newer-order.md)** (confirmed, supply): Word that an older crate has come or is still waiting wipes out the head's newer order in hand, so the Captain's no to the newer one is never read, and once HEAD-08 is fixed those it was for are never ordered for again
   - Fix: Together with HEAD-08, keep the Quartermaster's order number on the head's order from its Noted line, put the order number in every word about crates, and clear the order in hand only when the word is about that order
355. **[CHK-05](findings/CHK-05-the-engineering-every-room-gets-the-article.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): The Chief Engineer calls its meeting "in the Engineering" - every room name is given "the", fitting or not
   - Fix: Put the article on through one helper that knows which room names take one, and let the code that reads these lines back accept the name with or without it
356. **[MAP-09](findings/MAP-09-window-table-of-departments-disagrees-with-the-games-own.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): The window's own table of who answers to whom is matched by words inside titles and disagrees with the game's, so a Bridge Assistant and every Assistant are the Head of Personnel's staff and a Chef is nobody's
   - Fix: Have the server send each person's department and head job (from the job datum's departments_list) with the PDA list and the people in view, and drop the hand-written DEPARTMENTS table except as a fallback
357. **[TRUST-09](findings/TRUST-09-who-said-a-line-is-read-back-out-of-the-report-text.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Code reads who said a line back out of the report text, which holds the speaker's own words, so a speaker can make a line look like someone else's
   - Fix: Keep the sense event behind each report line and read the speaker, the handle and the words from its details, never by matching the line's text

---

# Gaps: missing or half built, for you to decide

Not faults in what is there, but things planned and not built, or never thought of. Most need your decision before anyone builds them. Same order: most important first, then the smallest piece of work.

## Gaps: critical (1)

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 1

358. **[HOLE-02](findings/HOLE-02-closing-the-window-wipes-every-brain-for-good.md)** (confirmed, design): Closing the brain window, or the owner dropping off, wipes every crew member's memory for good and nothing says so
   - Fix: Keep a copy of each brain's lasting memory on the server and hand it back when the window opens, log and announce when the window shuts, and open it again by itself when the owner is back

## Gaps: high (13)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 2

359. **[CORE-04](findings/CORE-04-one-runtime-in-ui-data-stops-the-window-for-every-body.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): One runtime error in ui_data, from any of its forty calls for any one body, stops every update to the window, so every crew member stalls while it lasts
   - Fix: Build each body's record in its own proc inside try and catch, and on an error log it once and send a short record for that body with an error field, so the others still get their update
360. **[MAP-01](findings/MAP-01-first-round-to-reach-the-shuttle-sends-the-next-to-kilostation.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The first test round that sees the emergency shuttle leave makes the next round KiloStation, where the crew has never been run
   - Fix: Pin the test server to MetaStation in config/maps.txt (the only votable map, with no minplayers) until the crew is checked on other maps, and say so in the change log, since the MAPROTATION flag is read by nothing

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 7

361. **[DRV-06](findings/DRV-06-one-thrown-error-stops-every-brain.md)** (confirmed, driver): One thrown error anywhere in the window code, for any one NPC, stops every brain for good and then costs all their memory
   - Fix: Catch errors per NPC in ingest and round the whole of think, chooseJob and readOrder, log them through brain_log, always free the LLM turn in a finally, and escape names built into RegExps
362. **[GAP-02](findings/GAP-02-crate-unpacked-by-forcemove-without-opening-it.md)** (confirmed, supply): A collected crate is unpacked by moving its contents in code, without opening it (no-cheats plan 4.6, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Open the crate by the click a player uses, leave everything on its tile, pull the open crate one tile clear, shut it, and take it back
363. **[GAP-04](findings/GAP-04-janitors-still-spawn-in-galoshes-and-nobody-walks-on-wet-floor.md)** (confirmed, janitor): Janitors are still given galoshes at spawn, and the plan's way to remove them clashes with the owner's ruling that a mopped floor is not seen (no-cheats plan 4.5 and 4.1)
   - Fix: Ask the owner whether a janitor may know the tiles it has just mopped, build that in knows_slippery, see it in a round, then delete the shoe swap in create_crew_npc
364. **[GAP-07](findings/GAP-07-no-cheats-read-through-and-check-script-never-done.md)** (confirmed, tools): The read-through for cheats and the check script that fails on new ones were approved and never done (no-cheats plan 4.9), a list of what is left
   - Fix: Add tools/llm_crew/cheats.ts that greps the crew code for a short list of calls against an allowed list, and put the list below to the owner
365. **[HOLE-11](findings/HOLE-11-body-never-presses-resist-unless-crew-security-arrested-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A crew member strapped to a chair, shut in a locker, set alight or cuffed by a player never tries to get free
   - Fix: Add one reflex to the body, run from look_around, that presses Resist the way a player would when it is buckled by someone else, shut in a container, on fire, or in cuffs with nobody holding it, and tells the brain what happened
366. **[MAP-03](findings/MAP-03-no-cargo-lobby-on-kilo-and-catwalk-stops-all-supply.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): KiloStation and CatwalkStation have no Cargo Lobby, so no crate can be put out, asked for at the counter, collected or brought back
   - Fix: Have the server work out the counter room from the post (the room on the far side of the service window or desk nearest the post spot), send its name to the brain as the counter, and use that name everywhere the window says Cargo Lobby
367. **[QM-07](findings/QM-07-given-order-has-no-deadline.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): An order a technician has said it has is waited on with no time limit, so any word that does not come back leaves that technician busy and the money spoken for until the round ends
   - Fix: Give a taken order a deadline past the server's six-minute shuttle limit, after which the Quartermaster asks the technician face to face whether it has come in, and failing an answer puts it back to be given again and tells whoever ordered

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 4

368. **[GAP-01](findings/GAP-01-supply-shuttle-still-moved-by-timer-and-by-code.md)** (confirmed, cargo): The supply shuttle is still sent and called home by code, from wherever the technician is (no-cheats plan 4.7, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Press send through work_window at the console as the owner allowed for machine windows, drop the timer that moves the shuttle, and make an order two presses at the console
369. **[GAP-05](findings/GAP-05-fire-doors-nobody-asks-engineering-and-server-says-if-alarm-is-real.md)** (confirmed, doors): Fire doors, the owner's chain to engineering is not built, and the server still tells every body whether an alarm is real
   - Fix: Drop crew_npc_alarm_was_pulled, reset once and leave the room if the doors shut again, and build the ask up the chain to an engineer who pries the door
370. **[HOLE-06](findings/HOLE-06-when-pdas-stop-nobody-walks-over-to-say-it.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): When PDA messages stop going out the crew are never told, word owed by PDA is dropped after eight minutes, and nobody walks over to say it
   - Fix: Tell the window when the body's PDA has not been sending, treat that as having no PDA, keep word that did not go, and add one general step that carries word to someone in person
371. **[HOLE-08](findings/HOLE-08-the-dead-and-the-silent-are-counted-on-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Whoever a PDA lists first with the job is "the officer" or "the head" for ever, whether they are dead, a player who does not answer, or a PDA in a locker
   - Fix: Keep, for each person a crew member relies on, a count of words sent and not answered and whether they were last seen down, pass over anyone who fails it when picking who holds a job, and tell its own head or the Captain once when someone has stopped answering

## Gaps: medium (62)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 9

372. **[ENG-10](findings/ENG-10-cooling-is-not-looked-at-again-before-the-emitters-go-on.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The engineer never looks again at the cooling it set before it switches the emitters on, though the server tells it how every machine in view stands
   - Fix: Before each emitter step, take back out of engine.done any step whose machine is in view and seen not to be as it was set, so that it is done again before the emitters
373. **[HOLE-04](findings/HOLE-04-no-admin-at-round-start-means-no-crew-all-round.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): With no admin connected ten seconds into the round there is no crew all round, and nothing is logged
   - Fix: Log why no crew was spawned, try again when an admin who may spawn connects, and name the owner in config instead of taking the first admin on the list
374. **[HOLE-12](findings/HOLE-12-what-the-body-answered-to-each-step-is-logged-nowhere.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): The logs say what each crew member was told to do and almost never how it went, so a round cannot be read back
   - Fix: Write every action result to the round's crew brain log from the server, with the tool, whether it went, and the words, and log tool calls the rate limit drops
375. **[KNA-08](findings/KNA-08-hurt-officer-with-a-baton-does-not-defend-itself.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A hurt officer with a working baton walks away from someone who follows and keeps hitting it
   - Fix: Let a hurt officer that is struck again while getting away stop its attacker with the baton, in self-defence only, if the owner agrees
376. **[KNA-21](findings/KNA-21-captains-pardon-to-the-officers-face-is-sent-on-not-done.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The Captain pardoning someone to the officer's face, with the prisoner in sight, is told to take it to the Head of Security, and nothing is done
   - Fix: Let an officer act on a pardon from the Captain itself, and pass it to the Head of Security as news, if the owner agrees that the Captain outranks the list
377. **[KNA-25](findings/KNA-25-staff-hear-of-a-warrant-only-at-the-next-meeting-read-out-before-the-wanted.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Staff hear of a warrant only at their head's next meeting, up to ten minutes late, and the list is read out with the wanted person standing in the room
   - Fix: Have a head pass a new name on the list to its staff by PDA at once, and leave out of the meeting line anyone on the list who is in the room, if the owner agrees
378. **[PARSE-10](findings/PARSE-10-captain-cannot-order-the-emitters-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The Captain cannot have the engine shut down - turn the emitters off, shut down the engine and kill the engine are read by nobody, to the Chief Engineer or the engineer
   - Fix: Read a shut-down order from anyone the Chief Engineer answers to, as LIGHT_AGAIN_WORDS is read, and have it give the engineer the same Emitters off order as a falling crystal does
379. **[SECT-20](findings/SECT-20-someone-walked-out-who-comes-straight-back-is-asked-afresh-for-ever.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Someone walked out of a post who comes straight back in is a stranger again, is asked why from the start, and is never reported however often they return
   - Fix: Keep a short record of who was put out of the post and when, walk a returner out without asking again, and tell the head the second time they come back
380. **[HOLE-16](findings/HOLE-16-crew-locked-in-a-cell-by-a-player-do-not-know-they-are-prisoners.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): A crew member locked in a brig cell by the Captain or any player does not know it is a prisoner, goes on with its work from the cell and asks to be let out
   - Fix: In look_around, when the body stands in a brig cell whose timer is running and it is in no custody, put it in custody of that cell the way put_in_custody does, with nobody named, so the existing cell phase holds it and lets it go when the timer stops

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 39

381. **[CARGO-20](findings/CARGO-20-a-player-quartermaster-cannot-get-a-technician-to-order-anything.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): A player who is Quartermaster cannot get a technician to order anything except in the NPC Quartermaster's exact words, and is told nothing it can answer in its own
   - Fix: When the Quartermaster aboard is not one of this window's NPCs, offer the model the order option for the Quartermaster's own asking, and take any plain acknowledgement from it as heard
382. **[CHK-02](findings/CHK-02-no-crew-test-runs-by-itself.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): None of the crew tests runs by itself - not in the build, not in CI, and the tools folder is never type checked or linted
   - Fix: Add one runner script that runs the tables, the dry model tests and the simulator scenarios and exits non-zero on any failure, and hang the quick part of it on the tgui test target
383. **[DESK-06](findings/DESK-06-called-to-a-locked-room-by-anyone-not-in-cargo-the-janitor-never-asks-in.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Called to a mess in a room locked to it by anyone but cargo, a janitor walks at the door every few minutes, never knocks or asks, and never tells the caller
   - Fix: Give any told mess task the let-in steps once a walk to its room fails for want of a way in, whoever called, and let anyone coming into view restart the asking, not only cargo
384. **[GAP-08](findings/GAP-08-order-asked-while-door-or-pickup-is-in-hand-is-still-lost.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): An order asked of a technician while someone wants a door or a crate is still lost (no-cheats plan 4.2, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Keep the ask in code when hears() is turned away by a door or a pick-up, tell the LLM the truth meanwhile, and place it from the kept words once the door is done
385. **[GAP-09](findings/GAP-09-janitor-call-and-let-out-words-do-not-say-what-is-true.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): A technician still does not know its workmate called a janitor, and a janitor leaving for water still says "I am done" (no-cheats plan 4.3, approved, not built)
   - Fix: Send who called whom in place of the yes or no, word the waiting step with it, and give the let-out message its true reason (done, dry mop, cannot shift it)
386. **[GAP-13](findings/GAP-13-nobody-notices-anyone-hurt-down-or-dead-the-harm-senses-are-off.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Nobody notices a person hurt, down or dead, the harm senses were written and never switched on
   - Fix: Call watch_for_harm from look_around for people in view, and build the one use the plans name, any crew member who sees someone lying still tells its head or the Captain once
387. **[GAP-14](findings/GAP-14-janitors-do-not-put-trespassers-out-of-their-own-rooms.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Janitors do not question or put out a trespasser in the Custodial Closet, the owner asked for it on 2026-11-18 and keeping a room is tied to having a post
   - Fix: Give every body a list of rooms it keeps (its department's locked rooms), key the guarding code on that list instead of the post, and add guarding to the janitor job
388. **[GAP-15](findings/GAP-15-loose-wording-is-forgiven-only-for-warrants-sent-by-pda.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): Loose wording and bad spelling are understood only for warrants and pardons sent to security by PDA, every other typed order still needs the exact words
   - Fix: Lift the forgiving speller and the small LLM reader out of security into shared code, and give each job's order reader a list of the orders it takes so the same last-resort question serves all of them
389. **[GAP-17](findings/GAP-17-nobody-leaves-a-room-for-bad-air-and-other-secure-area-leftovers.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): No body leaves a room because its air has turned bad or its alarm is ringing, and four more leftovers of the locked-areas plan
   - Fix: Have the server say when the air on the body's own tile is not fit to stand in, and have the driver treat that as the one emergency that comes before any job, walking to the nearest room it knows with good air
390. **[GAP-24](findings/GAP-24-a-pda-message-no-reader-knows-gets-no-answer-at-all.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A PDA message never wakes the voice, so anything sent by PDA that no job's reader knows gets no answer and no action, the Captain's orders to heads included
   - Fix: Have readsMessage say whether it used the message, and for one from a person that no reader used send a fixed acknowledgement by PDA, with the voice wording it when the model is up and GAP-15's reader trying it as an order
391. **[HOLE-03](findings/HOLE-03-crew-are-not-on-the-stations-books.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The crew are made outside the job system, so they hold no job slot, are not on the manifest and have no records or bank account
   - Fix: Give each body a mind and its job through SSjob when it is spawned, take the job's slot, and put it on the manifest, and skip any job a player already holds
392. **[HOLE-10](findings/HOLE-10-crew-of-two-owners-do-not-know-each-other-for-crew.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Crew owned by two players do not know each other for crew, and nobody can take over a crew whose owner has left
   - Fix: Have the server say of each person seen and heard whether they are a crew NPC, use that in place of "is in my window", and add an admin verb that hands a crew to another owner
393. **[HOLE-13](findings/HOLE-13-a-player-doing-a-crew-job-stalls-whoever-hands-them-work.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): A player holding a crew job is handed work like an NPC, and work waits for ever on set words a player will never say
   - Fix: Take any answer from the person a job was given to as their word that they have it, give a job that goes unanswered to someone else after a set number of tries, and call to a staff meeting only those who have answered a call before
394. **[HOLE-15](findings/HOLE-15-crew-never-see-an-emote-a-point-or-anything-done-in-front-of-them.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): The crew never see an emote, a point, or any of the game's "X does Y" lines, so a player who points at a mess, waves someone over or nods yes is not seen at all
   - Fix: When a person comes into view register for COMSIG_MOB_EMOTE and COMSIG_MOVABLE_POINTED on them, and emit a seen sense event with what they did and at what, for the window to keep as context and for the readers to use
395. **[HOLE-17](findings/HOLE-17-a-crew-member-arrested-by-a-player-walks-off-to-its-work.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A crew member arrested by a player, the Captain or a human officer, is not held, walks off to its work, and is only told so in its prompt
   - Fix: Give the body one general way to be arrested by anyone it answers to, read from what it hears and feels, which holds it still the way being_arrested does and lets it go on the same rules, and read the arrest words loosely
396. **[HOLE-19](findings/HOLE-19-requests-made-at-the-game-request-consoles-are-never-seen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): Supplies asked for the game's own way, at a supply request console, are never seen by cargo, so a player who orders as players do waits for good
   - Fix: Have a technician standing at its supply console read the console's request list the way its screen shows it, and pass each new request to the Quartermaster as an order taken from its orderer, approving it at the console once the Quartermaster says yes
397. **[HOLE-20](findings/HOLE-20-messages-to-a-department-requests-console-are-never-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A message sent to Janitorial, Security or Engineering at a wall requests console is never read, the console says aloud only who it is from, and the crew take that for machine chatter
   - Fix: When a crew body hears its own department's requests console announce a message, have it go to the console, read the newest message the way its screen shows it, and hand the text to the same readers a PDA message goes to
398. **[HOLE-21](findings/HOLE-21-a-player-put-into-a-crew-body-keeps-the-crew-controller.md)** (not checked, finder sure, core): A player put into a crew body keeps the crew controller, so they walk through people, the other crew treat them as one of their own, and the brain takes the body back when they leave
   - Fix: Have the crew controller notice COMSIG_MOB_LOGIN on its body, take PASSMOB off, tell the window the body is now a player's and drop it from the window's crew, and on logout not take the body back unless the owner says so
399. **[HOLE-24](findings/HOLE-24-a-note-handed-to-a-crew-member-is-put-down-unread.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): A paper note, form or order handed to a crew member is put down unread as something that is not its own, so writing is no way to reach the crew, not even when speech and PDAs fail
   - Fix: When a sheet of paper with writing on it comes into a crew hand from someone, read it the way the Quartermaster reads its own book and pass the text to the same readers a PDA message from that person goes to, then put it down or keep it as the job says
400. **[KNA-07](findings/KNA-07-officer-with-no-fresh-word-walks-only-primary-hallways.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): With no fresh word of a suspect the officer walks only rooms named Primary Hallway, and never looks beside where they were last seen
   - Fix: Look first in the rooms that open onto the room of the last sighting, then walk every hallway the station has, by kind of room and not by name
401. **[KNA-11](findings/KNA-11-engineer-does-not-force-the-room-in-between.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): An engineer sent to a door behind another locked room says so and stops, when it could force the outer door first
   - Fix: When the server says the way is through another locked room, force that room's door first and then go on to the door that was asked for
402. **[KNA-18](findings/KNA-18-shuttle-barred-technician-knows-why-and-does-nothing.md)** (not checked, finder sure, supply): When the supply shuttle will not leave, the technician is told what is barring it and has no step to clear it, and the Captain is not told
   - Fix: Give the technician a step for each thing what_bars_shuttle can name - carry a loose thing off the deck, ask a person to step off - and have the Quartermaster tell the Captain when an order has been held up
403. **[KNB-11](findings/KNB-11-no-engineer-no-engine-and-no-reading-no-watch.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): With no engineer free to do it nobody lights the engine, and with no PDA reading the Chief Engineer never orders the emitters off
   - Fix: Let the Chief Engineer take the engineer's lighting list itself when no engineer has taken the order, and go and look at the crystal when the monitor has told it nothing for some minutes
404. **[KNB-12](findings/KNB-12-locked-room-rules-are-given-out-job-by-job.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Having rooms of your own is handed out job by job, so janitors put nobody out of the Custodial Closet and cannot open their own door for anyone
   - Fix: Work out a body's own rooms from its ID and its job's department for every job, and let anyone with rooms of their own guard them and open their doors
405. **[MAP-08](findings/MAP-08-tramstation-crew-know-nothing-of-the-tram-or-its-crossings.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): On Tramstation the crew know nothing of the tram, so they cross the tracks without looking at the crossing signal and cannot ride it between the station's parts
   - Fix: Treat a tram track tile as a place to step onto only when the nearest crossing signal is green, as a player would, and leave riding the tram to the lift work in HOLE-05
406. **[PARSE-02](findings/PARSE-02-a-room-is-only-known-by-its-whole-exact-name.md)** (not checked, finder sure, brain): A room is found in what was said only by its whole exact name, so medbay, the captains office, the hop office, the dorms and hydro name no room
   - Fix: Give placeNamedIn a forgiving match - apostrophes optional, a room's distinctive word alone when only one room has it, and a short table of the usual station shorthands (hop, ce, qm, hydro, dorms, medbay)
407. **[PARSE-05](findings/PARSE-05-common-ways-to-order-an-arrest-are-not-read.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Cuff Bob, brig Bob, Bob needs arresting, I want Bob arrested, bring Dana in and arrest the monkey are none of them read as a warrant
   - Fix: Add the missing verbs and the passive and wish forms to readWarrant, read bring X in with the name between, and let the X be a job or the monkey when exactly one known person fits
408. **[SEC-14](findings/SEC-14-prisoner-held-while-the-officer-waits-works-the-cuffs-off-unseen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): A player held by the arm while the officer stands waiting works the cuffs off in a minute and walks away, and the officer never sees it start
   - Fix: While the body holds someone it arrested, listen on them for COMSIG_MOB_REMOVING_CUFFS, tell the brain what any onlooker sees, and have the officer break the attempt by a step or a tighter grip
409. **[SENSE-03](findings/SENSE-03-crew-see-no-one-who-is-not-human.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Crew see nobody who is not human, a cyborg talking to them, a space carp biting them or a xenomorph in their room is not in view at all
   - Fix: Report every living mob in view in look_around, humans as now and the rest as creatures with kind, name and whether hostile, and let handle_for take any mob/living
410. **[SENSE-09](findings/SENSE-09-fire-smoke-and-anomalies-are-not-seen.md)** (not checked, finder sure, senses): Fire, smoke and anomalies are never seen, so a body walks into flames and goes on mopping beside a burning room without a word
   - Fix: In look_around report hotspots, smoke and anomalies in sight as a hazard list, and keep the walk and the idle step off burning tiles
411. **[SIM-07](findings/SIM-07-stand-in-model-never-hangs-cuts-off-or-talks-nonsense.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in model answers every call in two and a half seconds with whole, well-formed JSON, so a slow, hung, cut-off or wayward model is never simulated
   - Fix: Add stand-in model modes slow, hung, cutoff, junk and wayward, honour the abort signal, and run the long scenarios in each
412. **[DOOR-05](findings/DOOR-05-free-exit-doors-not-known-to-the-crew.md)** (not checked, finder likely, doors): A door that lets anyone out from one side is taken as locked, so a body asks to be let out of somewhere it could walk out of
   - Fix: Teach the route planner that an airlock opens from its free-exit side, or failing that have a shut-in body look for such a door of its room and walk into it
413. **[HAND-10](findings/HAND-10-crate-jammed-in-a-doorway-is-cleared-for-a-walk-but-never-for-an-errand.md)** (not checked, finder likely, hands): A crate jammed in a doorway is moved when it shuts a walk, but never when it shuts an errand, so a held crate behind it is written off as one nobody can get to
   - Fix: When an errand's walk finds no way, try clear_the_way as walk_finished does before giving the errand up, with the errand kept in after_clearing to be taken up again
414. **[HOLE-22](findings/HOLE-22-nothing-holds-what-the-model-says-to-the-servers-rules.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): Nothing holds what the model says aloud or by PDA to the server's rules beyond the hard word filter, so any player can talk a crew member into saying what a player would be banned for, and no admin is told
   - Fix: Check the soft filter too and tell admins when the model trips either, refuse lines that speak of the model, the game or other players out of character, and give admins a verb to silence one crew member's voice
415. **[HOLE-23](findings/HOLE-23-a-bar-sign-renames-the-meeting-room-and-the-crew-lose-it.md)** (not checked, finder likely, core): Rooms are known by a name taken once at round start, so when a player sets the bar sign the Bar Lounge is renamed, the Head of Personnel's meetings there never gather, and the new name is no room at all
   - Fix: Key every room by its area (a stable id sent with the name) instead of by its display name, and when rename_area runs tell every crew controller and the window the room's new name
416. **[HOLE-26](findings/HOLE-26-the-window-sends-more-than-the-topic-limit-allows-a-non-admin.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The brain window sends the server two to three hundred calls a minute, over the game's topic limit, which only admins are spared, so an owner who deadmins, or any owner who is not an admin, has crew steps dropped and their own clicks refused
   - Fix: Batch the window's traffic into one call per update (acks, tool calls and log records together), keep it under the game's limits by a margin, and decide with the owner whether a crew owner is exempt from the topic limit by a check in client Topic
417. **[PERF-05](findings/PERF-05-one-model-is-a-quarter-busy-at-eleven-and-full-before-forty.md)** (not checked, finder likely, brain): The one model was a quarter busy with eleven crew and will be full before forty, and then every job choice costs its body eight seconds for nothing and every fixed line waits its turn for an optional remark
   - Fix: Under load, say a fixed line at once without its remark, skip the job choice when the talk queue is not empty, give a player's line the front of the queue, and log each call's wait in the queue
418. **[SECT-17](findings/SECT-17-no-hand-over-of-the-list-between-an-officer-and-a-head-of-security.md)** (not checked, finder likely, security): When a Head of Security comes aboard after an officer has kept the list, or leaves after it, the list is not handed over, and the old warrants drop out of sight
   - Fix: Have whoever stops keeping the list send it to whoever takes it up, in the fixed words of the notice, and have the new keeper read that notice into its desk
419. **[TRUST-10](findings/TRUST-10-crew-do-not-notice-their-id-taken-off-them.md)** (not checked, finder likely, senses): A crew member stands still while its ID card or PDA is taken off it, tells nobody, and then no longer knows its own job, while the thief is that head to every other crew member
   - Fix: Have every body notice when its card, PDA or bag leaves it for someone else's hands, tell the brain who took it, and keep the job it was given at spawn as its own whatever card it holds

### Large fix (a design change, or both halves): 14

420. **[GAP-06](findings/GAP-06-workmates-share-lists-in-code-that-no-body-could-sense.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Workmates share lists in code that no body saw, heard or was sent (the brief's decision 4 has quietly stopped being true)
   - Fix: Ask the owner whether a department's shared list is allowed, then either write the exception into the brief or carry each list by speech, PDA or something the body can read
421. **[GAP-10](findings/GAP-10-water-by-cart-the-cart-crate-and-a-bucket-asked-for-not-built.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Carrying water, the cart is never pulled or filled, cargo cannot order one, and a janitor short of a bucket tells nobody (no-cheats plan 4.4 and 4.1, half built)
   - Fix: Add the cart crate to orderable_crates, tell the head of a missing bucket as a need that does not stop work, then build pulling and filling a cart on the crate-hauling code
422. **[GAP-11](findings/GAP-11-light-replacer-plan-not-built-at-all.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): The light replacer (LLM_CREW_PLAN_LIGHTS.md), all six decisions accepted, none of it built
   - Fix: Build the plan's seven steps in its own order, starting with the server seeing dead fixtures by room
423. **[GAP-16](findings/GAP-16-security-plan-leftovers-in-one-list.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): Security, what the two plans decided or proposed and is still not built, in one list
   - Fix: Take the small ones (cuffs collected, a freed prisoner seen out, the sighting answered, a follow order) in one sitting and put the rest to the owner as a list
424. **[GAP-19](findings/GAP-19-engineering-answers-no-calls-and-no-fault-is-handed-on-between-jobs.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): Engineering lights the engine and nothing else, no power call is taken and no fault is handed on between jobs (engineering plan stages 2 and 3, and the owner's lights-out example)
   - Fix: Build stage 2 as a shared reporting duty plus a list of calls on the Chief Engineer, starting with the one call the game makes easy, a room's breaker that is off
425. **[GAP-22](findings/GAP-22-tests-the-plans-promised-and-never-wrote-or-ran.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): Tests the plans promised and never wrote or ran, no server code is ever exercised, the model has never been asked the new questions, and two scenarios fail by chance
   - Fix: Write the scenarios the plans list as the fixes for them are built, run the model cases once with the card free, pin the simulator's randomness so a failing run can be replayed, and add a checklist round for server code
426. **[HOLE-07](findings/HOLE-07-crew-hear-no-station-announcement-and-never-evacuate.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The crew hear no station announcement, so nobody goes to the emergency shuttle or takes note of an alert level
   - Fix: Give every conscious body on the station a sense event for each station announcement, and build one shared duty on top of it, going to the shuttle when it is called
427. **[SEC-08](findings/SEC-08-brig-with-no-power-holds-prisoners-for-good.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): When the brig loses power a prisoner is never let out, a pardon is dropped without a word, and a new prisoner is held by the arm for ever
   - Fix: Tell the brain a cell is dead (reason no_power), have security say so to its head and the Captain, and give it a player's way to open a dead cell door
428. **[SIM-04](findings/SIM-04-failure-paths-the-stand-in-server-can-never-give.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The stand-in server never gives most of the failures the real tools give, so the window code that handles them has never run
   - Fix: Give the stand-in a per-tool table of the real failures and a FAULTS switch that makes a named one happen, then add one scenario per job that runs with faults on
429. **[GAP-18](findings/GAP-18-cargo-and-quartermaster-plan-leftovers-in-one-list.md)** (not checked, finder likely, supply): Cargo and the Quartermaster, what five plans left unbuilt, in one list (an uncollected order is never sent back, the stuck shuttle is told to nobody, and more)
   - Fix: Build the uncollected order going back and the Quartermaster telling the Captain of a stuck shuttle first, both small, and put the rest to the owner as a list
430. **[HOLE-05](findings/HOLE-05-nothing-works-on-a-station-with-more-than-one-floor.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): On a station with more than one floor the crew cannot leave the floor they are spawned on, and jobs whose rooms are on another floor get no post
   - Fix: Turn on the route planner's multi-floor routes for crew, look for rooms on every station level, and send a body to the nearest floor of a room that it can reach
431. **[HOLE-09](findings/HOLE-09-what-breaks-first-with-a-whole-station-of-crew.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): A whole station of crew will not fit through one window as built, since every event from any body resends every body's whole state, and the brain log drops records without saying so
   - Fix: Send each body's slow-changing state on a timer and only its new events at once, count the brain log limit per body and log what is dropped, and measure the payload before adding more crew
432. **[HOLE-14](findings/HOLE-14-a-crew-member-given-a-new-job-is-half-old-job-half-new.md)** (not checked, finder likely, design): A crew member whose ID is given a new job, promoted to replace a dead head or demoted, is run by the new job in the window and the old one on the server
   - Fix: Have the server notice when the job on the body's own worn ID changes, learn that job's places again and send a knowledge event, and have the window start the new job's state fresh and drop the old job's tasks
433. **[SIM-05](findings/SIM-05-what-no-scenario-covers-by-job.md)** (not checked, finder likely, tools): What no scenario or table covers, by job, and no run is longer than 23 minutes
   - Fix: Add the scenarios listed here, most important first, each with checks that can fail, and one long scenario of an hour with power lost part way

## Gaps: low (17)

### Small fix (a few lines, one file): 11

434. **[CHK-03](findings/CHK-03-stale-compiled-tree-can-be-loaded-unnoticed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The crew's behaviour tree is read from a compiled copy on disk that the side compile does not rebuild and that cannot be checked on this machine
   - Fix: Add the tree check to the list of checks, with a command that works under Python 3.11, and mend the comment that says which defines the tree compiler reads
435. **[DESK-07](findings/DESK-07-word-that-a-mess-is-cleaned-goes-only-face-to-face.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Word that a mess someone called the janitor to is cleaned up is only ever said face to face, so a caller by PDA who is not there is never told
   - Fix: When a told mess task is done and the caller is not in view, send the sayDone line by PDA once, as orders.ts does for a report, and mark it reported
436. **[GAP-21](findings/GAP-21-the-brief-no-longer-describes-the-system-decisions-one-to-nine-checked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): The brief no longer describes the system, its nine decisions checked against today's code (three reversed on purpose and never written into it, three quietly untrue)
   - Fix: Rewrite sections 2, 5 and 6 of the brief to say what is true now, with the date and the owner's words for each reversal, and list what the brief promised that is still unbuilt
437. **[GAP-26](findings/GAP-26-plan-headers-and-change-log-summary-say-built-work-is-not-built.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): Six plans still open with "Planning only, nothing here is built", the no-cheats plan has no Status section, and the change log's summary calls two built plans unbuilt
   - Fix: Give the no-cheats plan a Status section at the top that says what is built (4.1, the mail chute, the water half of 4.4), change the six opening lines to point at the Status, and correct the change log's summary in a new top entry
438. **[HAND-06](findings/HAND-06-search-and-fetch-call-any-locker-that-will-not-open-locked.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): Searching and fetching call any locker that will not open locked, welded or blocked alike, and never unlock one the body's own card opens
   - Fix: Open storage with the click a player makes, so a locker its card opens is unlocked first, and report welded, blocked and locked apart
439. **[HEAD-11](findings/HEAD-11-staff-known-only-from-the-pda-list.md)** (not checked, finder sure, head): A head knows its staff only from its PDA's list, so a janitor with no PDA asking it face to face is ignored, and a head with no PDA has no staff, holds no meetings and orders nothing
   - Fix: Make staff() the PDA list joined with everyone in view whose ID puts them in the head's department, so word given face to face counts and the no-PDA paths in meetStep can run
440. **[JAN-11](findings/JAN-11-tidying-takes-things-from-under-and-beside-people.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cleaning): Tidying takes anything off the floor with no thought for whose it is, things a person has just put down, is standing on, or that fell from someone lying hurt
   - Fix: In wants_tidying leave alone a thing on or next to a tile with a living person other than the body, and ask the owner whether a fresh drop should be left a minute
441. **[KNA-27](findings/KNA-27-first-try-on-a-monkey-is-the-cuffs-alone.md)** (not checked, finder sure, security): The first go at anyone, a monkey included, is "Stand still" and the cuffs alone, which a monkey never stands for, so one of the three tries is spent for nothing
   - Fix: Send in each person in view whether they are a person or an animal, as the body sees it, and go straight to the baton for one that cannot be told to stand still, if the owner agrees
442. **[KNB-17](findings/KNB-17-thing-put-in-a-pocket-is-never-noticed.md)** (not checked, finder sure, hands): A thing Pun Pun puts in a crew member's pocket is never noticed or put down, only one put in a hand is
   - Fix: Let on_item_in_hand also take the two pocket slots, and have put_down_unasked_item take the thing out of the pocket by a click before it sets it down
443. **[PERF-04](findings/PERF-04-nothing-measures-what-the-crew-costs-the-server.md)** (not checked, finder sure, logs): Nothing measures what the crew costs the server, and the round's perf csv cannot show it, so a forty-crew round would show only lag with no cause
   - Fix: Count the time and the calls of ui_data, look_around and the sends to the window, and the bytes sent, and write them once a minute as one crew_cost line in game.log
444. **[QM-15](findings/QM-15-captain-asked-about-orders-the-budget-cannot-pay.md)** (not checked, finder sure, quartermaster): The Captain is asked twice to approve every order that the budget cannot pay at all, which at the start of a round is every order, since cargo starts with nothing
   - Fix: In clearOrders test the money first, hold an order the budget cannot cover and tell whoever ordered, and put it to the Captain only once it can be paid and is still big

### Medium fix (one part of the code): 5

445. **[CARGO-17](findings/CARGO-17-no-crew-member-ever-comes-for-their-mail.md)** (not checked, finder sure, cargo): No crew member ever comes for their mail, because no job reads the there is mail for you message, and a technician's own letter is sent to itself by PDA
   - Fix: Give the mail notice fixed words that every job reads in readPickup's way, so the person goes to the counter when free, and leave out the technician's own name from the mail it messages about
446. **[JAN-08](findings/JAN-08-engine-machine-list-worked-out-once-and-never-again.md)** (not checked, finder sure, engineering): The engine room's machines are worked out once a round, so a canister swapped onto a connector, or an emitter welded later, is never known, and the old one is walked to wherever it went
   - Fix: Work the canister and emitter entries out again when looked at - by the connector, not the canister - or rebuild the list when an entry no longer fits, keeping ids stable for the machines that did not change
447. **[JAN-12](findings/JAN-12-mopped-floor-left-wet-with-no-caution-sign.md)** (not checked, finder sure, janitor): Every tile a janitor mops is left slippery for up to a minute with no caution sign put out, and nothing warns anyone walking in
   - Fix: Ask the owner - put a wet floor sign (obj/item/clothing/suit/caution) down by the mopping when the janitor has one, and pick it up after, or say Wet floor aloud, as a player janitor does
448. **[MAP-10](findings/MAP-10-simulator-has-one-station-with-metastation-names.md)** (not checked, finder sure, tools): The simulator has one station, with MetaStation's room names written in, so nothing that depends on the map is ever tested and every map fault passes
   - Fix: Make the station in sim.ts a table chosen by name, add a second one with other names (no Cargo Lobby, no room called Brig, hallways not called Primary Hallway), and run the cargo and security scenarios on both
449. **[DESK-11](findings/DESK-11-janitors-share-out-no-work-and-go-to-the-same-mess-together.md)** (not checked, finder likely, janitor): Janitors share out no work, so two that have seen the same messes go to the same room in the same order, and neither leaves a room to another already in it
   - Fix: Leave a routine mess task alone for a while when another janitor is seen in that room, or is seen cleaning there, and let the order of rooms differ by janitor

450. **[GAP-25](findings/GAP-25-owner-design-direction-items-with-no-plan-and-no-code.md)** (not checked, finder sure, design): Six parts of the owner's design direction have no plan and no code, needs, how-to cards, a stocked work area, cover before a break, rooms handed out to janitors, and a raise
   - Fix: Put the six to the owner as one list, and write a short plan for whichever the owner wants next, starting with the head handing out rooms to its janitors, which is the cheapest and helps today
